target: The company has decided to cut its prices in order to attract more customers.
options: The company has decided not to change its prices, although it wants more customers.
The company has lowered its prices so as to draw in more customers.
The company has raised its prices because it already has too many customers.
The company has attracted more customers and therefore cut its prices.
answer: The company has lowered its prices so as to draw in more customers.
why: 'cut' = 'lowered'; 'in order to attract' = 'so as to draw in'. Amaç ilişkisi ve fiil eş anlamı korunuyor.
wrong: Fiyatı değiştirmeme kararı, hedefteki indirim kararıyla çelişir.
Fiyat artırmak, hedef cümledeki indirimin tersidir.
Neden-sonuç ters çevrilmiş: indirim amaçtır, sonuç değil.
tr: Şirket daha fazla müşteri çekmek için fiyatlarını düşürmeye karar verdi.
ruleText: in order to = so as to (amaç). Amaç, sonuç gibi okunursa neden-sonuç tersine döner.

target: Despite the heavy rain, the match went ahead as planned.
options: The match was cancelled because of the heavy rain.
The match took place as planned in spite of the heavy rain.
The match went ahead as planned because the rain was heavy.
The heavy rain began after the match had gone ahead as planned.
answer: The match took place as planned in spite of the heavy rain.
why: 'Despite' = 'in spite of'; 'went ahead' = 'took place'. Karşıtlık korunuyor.
wrong: İptal, hedefteki 'planlandığı gibi yapıldı' ile çelişir.
Zaman sırası değiştirilmiş: yağmur maçtan sonra başlamış.
tr: Şiddetli yağmura rağmen maç planlandığı gibi yapıldı.
ruleText: despite = in spite of (+ isim grubu). Karşıtlık bağlacı neden bağlacına dönüşemez.

target: She is too tired to continue working.
options: She is so tired that she cannot continue working.
She continues working although she is very tired.
She is not tired, so she continues working.
She is tired enough to continue working.
answer: She is so tired that she cannot continue working.
why: 'too tired to' = 'so tired that she cannot'. Olumsuz sonuç korunuyor.
wrong: Çalışmaya devam ediyor, hedef ise devam edemediğini söyler.
'enough to' devam edebildiğini söyler, hedefin tersi.
tr: O çalışmaya devam edemeyecek kadar yorgun.
ruleText: too + sıfat + to = so + sıfat + that + cannot. Sonuç olumsuzdur.

target: No sooner had the lecturer finished speaking than the students began to ask questions.
options: The students had finished asking questions by the time the lecturer began speaking.
The students began to ask questions before the lecturer had finished speaking.
As soon as the lecturer had finished speaking, the students began to ask questions.
The lecturer finished speaking because the students began to ask questions.
answer: As soon as the lecturer had finished speaking, the students began to ask questions.
why: 'No sooner ... than' = 'as soon as'. Önce konuşma biter, hemen ardından sorular başlar.
wrong: Sıra ters: sorular konuşma bitmeden başlamış.
tr: Öğretim görevlisi konuşmasını bitirir bitirmez öğrenciler soru sormaya başladı.
ruleText: No sooner + had + özne + V3 + than = as soon as. Olumsuz zarf başa gelince devrik yapı kurulur.

target: Unless you submit the form by Friday, your application will not be considered.
options: Your application will be considered only if you submit the form by Friday.
Submitting the form by Friday is unnecessary for your application to be considered.
If you submit the form by Friday, your application will not be considered.
Your application will be considered even if you submit the form after Friday.
answer: Your application will be considered only if you submit the form by Friday.
why: 'Unless' = 'if not'; 'only if' ile aynı koşulu verir: formu Cuma'ya kadar vermezsen başvuru değerlendirilmez.
wrong: Formu vermeyi gereksiz sayıyor, hedef onu şart koşuyor.
Koşul ters: formu vermek başvuruyu reddettirir.
Cuma'dan sonra verilse de kabul edilir diyor, hedefle çelişir.
tr: Formu Cuma gününe kadar teslim etmezseniz başvurunuz değerlendirilmeyecek.
ruleText: unless = if ... not = only if. 'Unless' olumsuz koşulu tek sözcükle verir.

target: The more experience you gain, the easier it becomes to solve such problems.
options: Solving such problems becomes harder as you gain more experience.
You will solve such problems easily only if you have little experience.
As you gain more experience, solving such problems gets progressively easier.
Experience is gained more easily when you have solved such problems.
answer: As you gain more experience, solving such problems gets progressively easier.
why: 'The more ..., the easier' = 'as you gain more ..., gets easier'. Orantılı artış korunuyor.
tr: Deneyim kazandıkça bu tür sorunları çözmek kolaylaşır.
ruleText: the + karşılaştırma, the + karşılaştırma = as + özne + fiil, daha ... olur (orantılı değişim).

target: The manager is believed to have left the country before the investigation began.
options: People believe that the manager will leave the country before the investigation begins.
The manager is believed to have started the investigation before leaving the country.
People believe that the manager left the country before the investigation began.
The manager left the country because he believed the investigation had begun.
answer: People believe that the manager left the country before the investigation began.
why: 'is believed to have left' = 'people believe that ... left'. Geçmişe ait olay korunuyor.
tr: Müdürün soruşturma başlamadan önce ülkeyi terk ettiğine inanılıyor.
ruleText: is believed + to have V3 = people believe that ... V2. 'to have V3' geçmişi gösterir.

target: Few people would deny that education plays a crucial role in economic development.
options: Education plays a crucial role only for the few people who study economics.
Few people believe that economic development is important for education.
Many people deny that education has any effect on economic development.
Most people would accept that education is vital for economic development.
answer: Most people would accept that education is vital for economic development.
why: 'Few would deny' = neredeyse herkes kabul eder. Çift olumsuz anlam olumluya döner.
wrong: 'few' başka bir yere taşınmış, anlam bozulmuş.
Çoğu insan reddediyor demek tam tersi.
tr: Eğitimin ekonomik kalkınmada çok önemli bir rol oynadığını az insan inkâr eder.
ruleText: few + deny = çok kişi kabul eder. 'Few' olumsuzluk taşır, deny ile çift olumsuzluk olumluya döner.

target: Had it not been for the scholarship she received, she would have been unable to afford the tuition fees, let alone the cost of accommodation.
options: She received the scholarship, so she was unable to afford the accommodation costs.
Because of the scholarship, she could afford neither the tuition fees nor the accommodation.
Without the scholarship, she could not have paid even the tuition fees, much less her accommodation costs.
She could afford the accommodation costs, but she would have struggled to pay the tuition fees.
answer: Without the scholarship, she could not have paid even the tuition fees, much less her accommodation costs.
why: 'Had it not been for' = 'Without'; 'let alone' = 'much less'. Burs olmasaydı harçları bile ödeyemezdi, barınma hiç.
wrong: Burs aldığı için ödeyemedi denerek neden-sonuç bozulmuş.
Burs yüzünden ödeyemedi demek, bursun işlevini tersine çevirir.
tr: Aldığı burs olmasaydı harçları bile ödeyemezdi, barınma masraflarını hiç.
ruleText: Had it not been for + isim = Without + isim. 'let alone' = bir şeyi söylemişken ondan da fazlasını reddeder.

target: Seldom do scientists agree on the interpretation of data to the extent that further debate becomes unnecessary.
options: Scientists often agree so completely on interpreting data that debate is unnecessary.
Scientists rarely debate the interpretation of data because they usually agree on it.
Further debate becomes unnecessary only when scientists disagree on how data should be interpreted.
Scientists rarely reach such complete agreement on interpreting data that no more debate is needed.
answer: Scientists rarely reach such complete agreement on interpreting data that no more debate is needed.
why: 'Seldom do' = 'rarely'; 'to the extent that' = 'such ... that'. Nadiren bu kadar tam fikir birliğine varırlar.
wrong: Tartışmanın nadir olduğunu söyler, hedef ise uzlaşmanın nadir olduğunu.
tr: Bilim insanları verilerin yorumu konusunda daha fazla tartışmayı gereksiz kılacak kadar nadiren uzlaşır.
ruleText: Seldom/Rarely + do + özne = olumsuz zarf başa gelince devrik yapı. to the extent that = such ... that.

target: Doctors advise patients to avoid eating too much salt.
options: Doctors advise patients to eat as much salt as possible.
Patients advise doctors to cut down on their salt intake.
Doctors avoid giving advice about salt to their patients.
Patients are advised by doctors not to consume excessive amounts of salt.
answer: Patients are advised by doctors not to consume excessive amounts of salt.
why: Etken çatı edilgene çevrilmiş; 'avoid eating too much' = 'not consume excessive amounts'.
wrong: Hedefin tam tersi: mümkün olduğunca çok tuz.
Özneler yer değiştirmiş: hastalar doktora tavsiye veriyor.
tr: Doktorlar hastalara fazla tuz yememelerini tavsiye ediyor.
ruleText: Etken → edilgen: özne ve nesne yer değiştirir ama anlam aynı kalır. Eş anlamlı ifadeler: avoid eating too much = not consume excessive amounts.

target: The patient recovered quickly thanks to the new treatment.
options: The new treatment was developed after the patient recovered.
The patient recovered quickly in spite of the new treatment.
The patient recovered quickly, which led to the new treatment.
The new treatment enabled the patient to recover quickly.
answer: The new treatment enabled the patient to recover quickly.
why: 'thanks to' = 'enabled'. Yeni tedavi iyileşmeyi mümkün kıldı.
wrong: 'in spite of' tedaviyi iyileşmeye engel gibi gösterir.
tr: Hasta yeni tedavi sayesinde hızla iyileşti.
ruleText: thanks to + isim = bir şeyin sağladığı sonuç (enable, make it possible).

target: Although the vaccine is safe, some parents still hesitate to give it to their children.
options: In spite of the vaccine's safety, some parents are still reluctant to have their children vaccinated.
The vaccine is unsafe, so some parents hesitate to give it.
Because the vaccine is safe, some parents are reluctant to vaccinate their children.
Some parents give the vaccine to their children even though they believe it is unsafe.
answer: In spite of the vaccine's safety, some parents are still reluctant to have their children vaccinated.
why: 'Although' = 'In spite of'; 'hesitate' = 'be reluctant'. Karşıtlık korunuyor.
wrong: Güvenli olduğu için çekinme, karşıtlığı neden-sonuca çevirir.
Çekinen ebeveynleri aşı yaptıran ebeveynlere çevirir.
tr: Aşı güvenli olmasına rağmen bazı ebeveynler hâlâ çocuklarına yaptırmaktan çekiniyor.
ruleText: although + cümle = in spite of + isim grubu. hesitate = be reluctant.

target: Not only did the new drug reduce the symptoms, but it also shortened the recovery time.
options: The new drug reduced the symptoms, but it lengthened the recovery time.
The new drug shortened the recovery time, but it did not reduce the symptoms.
The symptoms were reduced because the recovery time was shortened.
The new drug both reduced the symptoms and made recovery quicker.
answer: The new drug both reduced the symptoms and made recovery quicker.
why: 'Not only ... but also' = 'both ... and'. İki olumlu etki de korunuyor.
tr: Yeni ilaç yalnızca belirtileri azaltmakla kalmadı, iyileşme süresini de kısalttı.
ruleText: Not only + yardımcı fiil + özne ... but also = both ... and. Devrik yapı vurgu içindir.

target: Were the patient to refuse treatment, the doctors would have to respect his decision.
options: The patient would accept treatment only if the doctors respected his decision.
The patient refused treatment, so the doctors had to respect his decision.
In the event that the patient declined treatment, the doctors would be obliged to accept his choice.
The doctors would refuse treatment unless the patient respected their decision.
answer: In the event that the patient declined treatment, the doctors would be obliged to accept his choice.
why: 'Were ... to refuse' = 'In the event that ... declined'. Varsayımsal durum korunuyor.
tr: Hasta tedaviyi reddederse doktorlar onun kararına saygı göstermek zorunda kalırdı.
ruleText: Were + özne + to V = If + özne + were to V (varsayımsal). Gerçek bir olay değil, olasılıktır.

target: Rarely does a single factor explain why some people develop heart disease.
options: A single factor seldom accounts for why some people develop heart disease.
Some people develop heart disease because they rarely consider a single factor.
Heart disease rarely develops in people who have a single risk factor.
A single factor always explains why some people develop heart disease.
answer: A single factor seldom accounts for why some people develop heart disease.
why: 'Rarely does' = 'seldom'; 'explain' = 'account for'.
wrong: Konu kayıyor: tek risk faktörü olanlarda hastalığın nadir olduğu söyleniyor.
tr: Kalp hastalığının neden bazı insanlarda geliştiğini tek bir etken nadiren açıklar.
ruleText: Rarely/Seldom + do/does + özne + V = olumsuz zarf başa gelince devrik yapı.

target: The nurse must have forgotten to record the dose, since the chart is blank.
options: The nurse was told to forget the dose because the chart is blank.
The blank chart suggests that the nurse almost certainly forgot to record the dose.
The chart is blank because the nurse has not yet been asked to record the dose.
The nurse may possibly record the dose later, since the chart is blank.
answer: The blank chart suggests that the nurse almost certainly forgot to record the dose.
why: 'must have forgotten' = 'almost certainly forgot'. Mantıksal çıkarım, güçlü olasılık.
wrong: Kayıt istenmediği için boş diye yeni bir neden uydurulmuş.
Geleceğe ait olasılık, hedefteki geçmiş çıkarımı değil.
tr: Çizelge boş olduğuna göre hemşire dozu kaydetmeyi unutmuş olmalı.
ruleText: must have + V3 = geçmiş hakkında güçlü çıkarım (neredeyse kesin).

target: It was only after the symptoms had worsened that he decided to consult a doctor.
options: He consulted a doctor, and then his symptoms got worse.
His symptoms worsened because he decided not to consult a doctor at all.
He did not consult a doctor until his symptoms had got worse.
He decided to consult a doctor as soon as the symptoms appeared.
answer: He did not consult a doctor until his symptoms had got worse.
why: 'only after ... that' = 'did not ... until'. Doktora gitmeden önce belirtiler kötüleşmiş.
wrong: Belirtiler ilk göründüğünde gitmiş, hedefte kötüleşmeden sonra.
tr: Doktora gitmeye ancak belirtiler kötüleştikten sonra karar verdi.
ruleText: It was only after ... that = not ... until. İki cümle aynı zaman sırasını verir.

target: Given the extent to which antibiotic resistance has spread, it would be unwise to assume that routine infections will remain easily treatable.
options: Antibiotic resistance has spread because people assumed that ordinary infections were untreatable.
Because antibiotic resistance is so widespread, one cannot safely expect ordinary infections to stay simple to cure.
Since antibiotic resistance is limited, ordinary infections are likely to stay simple to cure.
It is unwise to treat infections routinely, since resistance only spreads when antibiotics are not used.
answer: Because antibiotic resistance is so widespread, one cannot safely expect ordinary infections to stay simple to cure.
why: 'Given the extent' = 'Because ... so widespread'; 'unwise to assume' = 'cannot safely expect'.
wrong: Direnç sınırlı denmiş, hedef ise yaygın.
tr: Antibiyotik direncinin ne ölçüde yayıldığını göz önünde bulundurursak, sıradan enfeksiyonların kolay tedavi edilebilir kalacağını varsaymak akılsızca olur.
ruleText: Given + isim = ...göz önüne alınca. unwise to assume = güvenle bekleyemezsin.

target: So severe was the outbreak that hospitals, ill-equipped as they were, struggled to isolate patients.
options: The outbreak was so serious that hospitals, which lacked adequate equipment, found it hard to isolate patients.
Although the outbreak was mild, hospitals struggled because they were poorly equipped.
Hospitals were so well equipped that they isolated patients easily despite the outbreak.
The outbreak became severe because hospitals could not isolate patients.
answer: The outbreak was so serious that hospitals, which lacked adequate equipment, found it hard to isolate patients.
why: 'So severe was ... that' = 'was so serious that'; 'ill-equipped as they were' = 'which lacked adequate equipment'.
wrong: Salgın hafif denmiş, hedef ise ağır.
Hastaneler iyi donanımlı denmiş, hedefle çelişir.
tr: Salgın o kadar ağırdı ki donanımı yetersiz hastaneler hastaları izole etmekte zorlandı.
ruleText: So + sıfat + was + özne + that = o kadar ... ki. ill-equipped as they were = donanımsız olmalarına rağmen/ olduğu için.

target: Water boils at a lower temperature at high altitudes because the air pressure is lower.
options: Water boils at a higher temperature at high altitudes because the air pressure is lower.
At high altitudes, the lower air pressure causes water to boil at a lower temperature.
Water does not boil at high altitudes since the air pressure is lower.
The air pressure is lower at high altitudes because water boils at a lower temperature.
answer: At high altitudes, the lower air pressure causes water to boil at a lower temperature.
why: 'because the air pressure is lower' = 'the lower air pressure causes'. Neden-sonuç yönü korunuyor.
wrong: Sıcaklık yönü ters: daha yüksek sıcaklıkta kaynıyor.
tr: Yüksek rakımlarda hava basıncı düşük olduğu için su daha düşük sıcaklıkta kaynar.
ruleText: because + cümle = causes/leads to. Neden ile sonuç yer değiştirirse anlam bozulur.

target: Plants cannot survive without sunlight.
options: Sunlight can survive only with the help of plants.
Plants survive more easily without sunlight.
Plants sometimes need sunlight to survive.
Sunlight is essential for the survival of plants.
answer: Sunlight is essential for the survival of plants.
why: 'cannot survive without' = 'is essential for the survival of'.
wrong: Tam tersi: ışıksız daha kolay hayatta kalma.
tr: Bitkiler güneş ışığı olmadan hayatta kalamaz.
ruleText: cannot ... without = ... is essential for. Zorunluluğu 'sometimes' gibi sözcükler zayıflatır.

target: Scarcely had the sample been heated when it began to change colour.
options: The sample changed colour because it was heated for a long time.
The sample began to change colour almost immediately after it had been heated.
The sample was heated only after it had begun to change colour.
The sample hardly changed colour although it was heated.
answer: The sample began to change colour almost immediately after it had been heated.
why: 'Scarcely ... when' = 'almost immediately after'. Isıtma bitince hemen renk değişimi başlıyor.
wrong: 'uzun süre' bilgisi hedefte yok, hedef 'hemen' diyor.
Neredeyse hiç değişmediği söylenmiş, oysa değişmeye başlamış.
tr: Örnek ısıtılır ısıtılmaz renk değiştirmeye başladı.
ruleText: Scarcely/Hardly + had + özne + V3 + when = as soon as.

target: Only when the temperature drops below zero does water turn into ice.
options: Water turns into ice whenever the temperature rises above zero.
Water never turns into ice, even when the temperature drops below zero.
The temperature drops below zero only when water turns into ice.
Water freezes only if the temperature falls below zero.
answer: Water freezes only if the temperature falls below zero.
why: 'Only when' = 'only if'; 'turn into ice' = 'freeze'; 'drops below zero' = 'falls below zero'.
wrong: Sıfırın üzerinde donma diye ters bir koşul.
tr: Su, yalnızca sıcaklık sıfırın altına düştüğünde buza dönüşür.
ruleText: Only when + cümle + yardımcı fiil + özne = ancak ... olduğunda. Koşulun yönü değişmemeli.

target: The faster the molecules move, the higher the temperature of the substance becomes.
options: As molecules move more quickly, the substance gets hotter.
Molecules move quickly only in substances that are cold.
The substance gets hotter, so the molecules stop moving.
As molecules move more slowly, the substance gets hotter.
answer: As molecules move more quickly, the substance gets hotter.
why: 'The faster ..., the higher the temperature' = 'as ... more quickly, ... gets hotter'.
tr: Moleküller ne kadar hızlı hareket ederse maddenin sıcaklığı o kadar yükselir.
ruleText: the + karşılaştırma ..., the + karşılaştırma = orantılı artış.

target: The experiment would have succeeded had the researchers controlled the temperature more carefully.
options: The experiment will succeed if the researchers control the temperature more carefully.
The researchers controlled the temperature carefully, but the experiment failed anyway.
The experiment succeeded because the researchers controlled the temperature carefully.
The experiment failed because the researchers did not control the temperature carefully enough.
answer: The experiment failed because the researchers did not control the temperature carefully enough.
why: Gerçek dışı geçmiş koşul: deney başarısız oldu, çünkü sıcaklık yeterince kontrol edilmedi.
wrong: Sıcaklığı dikkatli kontrol etmiş gibi, oysa etmedi.
Gerçeğin tersi: deney başarılı olmuş gibi.
tr: Araştırmacılar sıcaklığı daha dikkatli kontrol etseydi deney başarılı olurdu.
ruleText: Had + özne + V3 = If + özne + had V3. Üçüncü tip koşul, gerçeğin tersini ima eder.

target: Little is known about what lies beneath the ice of Europa, one of Jupiter's moons.
options: Nothing lies beneath the ice of Europa, as far as scientists know.
Scientists are little known for what they have discovered beneath Europa's ice.
Scientists know very little about the region under the ice on Europa, a moon of Jupiter.
Much is known about the ice that lies beneath Europa, one of Jupiter's moons.
answer: Scientists know very little about the region under the ice on Europa, a moon of Jupiter.
why: 'Little is known' = 'Scientists know very little'.
tr: Jüpiter'in uydularından Europa'nın buzunun altında ne olduğu hakkında çok az şey biliniyor.
ruleText: Little is known = çok az şey biliniyor (edilgen, olumsuz anlamlı). 'Little' ≠ 'nothing'.

target: Were it not for the Earth's atmosphere, which absorbs most harmful radiation, life as we know it could hardly have developed.
options: The atmosphere developed after life began to absorb most harmful radiation.
Life as we know it could scarcely have developed without the atmosphere that absorbs most harmful radiation.
Life developed easily on Earth because the atmosphere lets harmful radiation through.
Although the atmosphere absorbs harmful radiation, life could have developed without it.
answer: Life as we know it could scarcely have developed without the atmosphere that absorbs most harmful radiation.
why: 'Were it not for' = 'without'; 'could hardly have developed' = 'could scarcely have developed'.
wrong: Atmosferle yaşam arasındaki neden-sonuç ters çevrilmiş.
Atmosferin radyasyonu geçirdiği söylenmiş, oysa emiyor.
Atmosfersiz de gelişebilirdi denmiş, hedef tam tersini söylüyor.
tr: Zararlı radyasyonun çoğunu emen atmosfer olmasaydı, bildiğimiz hayat gelişemezdi.
ruleText: Were it not for + isim = Without + isim. could hardly have V3 = neredeyse imkânsızdı.

target: Contrary to what was once believed, the speed at which an object falls does not depend on its mass, provided that air resistance is negligible.
options: Earlier views were wrong: when air resistance can be ignored, objects fall at the same rate whatever their mass.
It was once believed that mass is unimportant, but air resistance has since proved otherwise.
Air resistance is negligible only when objects fall at a speed that depends on their mass.
As people used to think, heavier objects fall faster even when air resistance is negligible.
answer: Earlier views were wrong: when air resistance can be ignored, objects fall at the same rate whatever their mass.
why: 'Contrary to what was once believed' = 'Earlier views were wrong'; 'provided that' = 'when ... can be ignored'.
wrong: Eski görüş ile yeni bulgu yer değiştirmiş.
Hava direnci ile kütle ilişkisi ters kurulmuş.
Eski görüşü doğru kabul ediyor, oysa hedef onu çürütüyor.
tr: Bir zamanlar düşünülenin aksine, hava direnci ihmal edilebilirse bir nesnenin düşme hızı kütlesine bağlı değildir.
ruleText: Contrary to = ...in aksine. provided that = ...koşuluyla (as long as).

target: No matter how precisely a measurement is made, some degree of uncertainty is bound to remain.
options: Measurements are made precisely only when some uncertainty is accepted.
Uncertainty remains because measurements are not made as precisely as before.
However accurate a measurement may be, it will inevitably contain some uncertainty.
A measurement that is accurate enough will eventually contain no uncertainty.
answer: However accurate a measurement may be, it will inevitably contain some uncertainty.
why: 'No matter how precisely' = 'However accurate'; 'is bound to remain' = 'will inevitably contain'.
wrong: Ölçümlerin eskisinden az hassas olduğu uydurulmuş.
Yeterince doğru ölçümde belirsizlik tamamen yok olur denmiş.
tr: Bir ölçüm ne kadar hassas yapılırsa yapılsın, bir miktar belirsizlik mutlaka kalır.
ruleText: No matter how + sıfat/zarf = However. be bound to V = kaçınılmaz olarak ... olur.

target: The government has introduced new laws to reduce unemployment.
options: The government has abolished its laws on unemployment.
New legislation has been brought in by the government in order to lower unemployment.
New laws have increased unemployment since the government introduced them.
Unemployment has been reduced, so the government has introduced new laws.
answer: New legislation has been brought in by the government in order to lower unemployment.
why: 'introduced new laws' = 'brought in new legislation'; 'to reduce' = 'in order to lower'.
wrong: Amaç sonuç gibi sunulmuş, neden-sonuç ters.
tr: Hükümet işsizliği azaltmak için yeni yasalar çıkardı.
ruleText: to + V = in order to + V (amaç). Edilgen yapı ve eş anlamlı sözcükler anlamı bozmaz.

target: Many young people prefer living in cities because they offer more job opportunities.
options: Cities attract many young people owing to the greater number of jobs they provide.
Many young people dislike cities despite the job opportunities.
Cities offer more job opportunities because many young people prefer living in them.
Few young people live in cities, which offer fewer jobs.
answer: Cities attract many young people owing to the greater number of jobs they provide.
why: 'because they offer more job opportunities' = 'owing to the greater number of jobs'.
wrong: Az genç yaşıyor ve az iş var denmiş.
tr: Birçok genç, daha fazla iş fırsatı sunduğu için şehirlerde yaşamayı tercih ediyor.
ruleText: because + cümle = owing to/due to + isim. Nedenin yönü korunmalı.

target: Hardly had the new policy been announced when protests broke out in several cities.
options: The new policy was announced after protests had broken out in several cities.
Protests erupted in several cities almost as soon as the new policy was announced.
Protests in several cities were hardly noticed when the policy was announced.
Protests broke out in several cities because the policy had not been announced.
answer: Protests erupted in several cities almost as soon as the new policy was announced.
why: 'Hardly ... when' = 'almost as soon as'; 'broke out' = 'erupted'.
wrong: Sıra ters: önce protesto, sonra duyuru.
tr: Yeni politika açıklanır açıklanmaz birkaç şehirde protestolar patlak verdi.
ruleText: Hardly + had + özne + V3 + when = as soon as.

target: It is high time the authorities took action to protect historic buildings.
options: Action to protect historic buildings is long overdue, and the authorities ought to take it now.
The authorities took action to protect historic buildings a long time ago.
It would be better for the authorities not to take action to protect historic buildings.
Historic buildings are protected only when the authorities find time.
answer: Action to protect historic buildings is long overdue, and the authorities ought to take it now.
why: 'It is high time ... took' = 'is long overdue ... ought to take it now'. Geçmiş zaman kalıbı şimdiki bir gecikmeyi anlatır.
wrong: Koşulsuz gecikme yerine rastgele zaman bulma uydurulmuş.
tr: Yetkililerin tarihî binaları korumak için harekete geçmesinin tam zamanı.
ruleText: It is high time + özne + V2 = ...nin tam zamanı (şimdiki zaman anlamı, geçmiş biçim).

target: Whether or not the reform succeeds will depend largely on public support.
options: The reform will succeed only if the public does not support it.
Public support will depend on whether the reform has already succeeded.
The reform's success will be shaped largely by public backing.
The reform will succeed regardless of public support.
answer: The reform's success will be shaped largely by public backing.
why: 'depend largely on' = 'be determined to a great extent by'.
wrong: Bağımlılık yönü ters: destek reformun sonucuna bağlanmış.
tr: Reformun başarılı olup olmaması büyük ölçüde halkın desteğine bağlı olacak.
ruleText: depend on = be determined by. Bağımlılık yönü (hangisi neye bağlı) değişmemeli.

target: Rather than raise taxes, the government chose to cut public spending.
options: The government decided to reduce public spending instead of increasing taxes.
The government cut taxes rather than reduce public spending.
The government decided to raise taxes instead of cutting public spending.
The government cut public spending and raised taxes as well.
answer: The government decided to reduce public spending instead of increasing taxes.
why: 'Rather than raise taxes' = 'instead of increasing taxes'; 'cut spending' = 'reduce spending'.
wrong: Seçilen ve reddedilen politika yer değiştirmiş.
tr: Hükümet vergileri artırmak yerine kamu harcamalarını kısmayı seçti.
ruleText: rather than + V = instead of + V-ing. Tercih edilen ve reddedilen seçenek yer değiştirmemeli.

target: Nobody could deny that the festival had brought considerable benefits to the town, though not everyone profited equally.
options: The festival benefited only those who could deny profiting from it.
Nobody admitted that the festival had benefited the town, because the gains were shared equally.
Everybody had to admit that the festival clearly benefited the town, although unevenly.
Everyone profited equally from the festival, though some denied it.
answer: Everybody had to admit that the festival clearly benefited the town, although unevenly.
why: 'Nobody could deny' = 'Everybody had to admit'; 'not everyone profited equally' = 'gains unevenly shared'.
wrong: Kimsenin kabul etmediği söylenmiş, hedefin tersi.
Eşit pay denmiş, hedef eşitsizlik diyor.
tr: Kimse festivalin kasabaya hatırı sayılır yararlar getirdiğini inkâr edemezdi, ancak herkes eşit kazanç sağlamadı.
ruleText: Nobody could deny = Everybody had to admit. Çift olumsuzluk ya da olumsuz özne olumluya çevrilir.

target: Little did the planners realise that the scheme, designed to ease traffic, would in fact make congestion worse.
options: The planners knew that congestion would get worse, so they designed a scheme to ease traffic.
Congestion was eased because the planners realised the scheme would make it worse.
The planners realised that the scheme would ease traffic but made congestion worse anyway.
The planners failed to foresee that a scheme intended to reduce traffic would actually aggravate congestion.
answer: The planners failed to foresee that a scheme intended to reduce traffic would actually aggravate congestion.
why: 'Little did ... realise' = 'failed to foresee'; 'make worse' = 'aggravate'.
tr: Planlayıcılar, trafiği rahatlatmak için tasarlanan planın aslında sıkışıklığı artıracağını hiç öngörmedi.
ruleText: Little did + özne + V = hiç ... etmedi (farkında değildi). Olumsuz zarf devrik yapı ister.

target: Not only is rapid urbanisation straining public services, but it is also, in many regions, widening the gap between rich and poor.
options: Rapid urbanisation is straining public services, so the gap between rich and poor has disappeared.
Public services are straining urbanisation, which is narrowing the gap between rich and poor.
Rapid urbanisation is reducing the pressure on public services but widening the gap between rich and poor.
In many regions, fast urban growth both puts pressure on public services and increases inequality.
answer: In many regions, fast urban growth both puts pressure on public services and increases inequality.
why: 'Not only ... but also' = 'both ... and'; 'widening the gap' = 'increases inequality'.
wrong: Özneler yer değiştirmiş ve fark daralmış.
tr: Hızlı kentleşme birçok bölgede yalnızca kamu hizmetlerini zorlamakla kalmıyor, zengin ile yoksul arasındaki farkı da açıyor.
ruleText: Not only + yardımcı fiil + özne ... but also = both ... and. widening the gap = eşitsizliği artırma.

target: Such was the scale of the economic crisis that few households, however prudent, escaped some loss of income.
options: Prudent households escaped the crisis, which was not large in scale.
The crisis was so big that nearly all households, even careful ones, lost income.
The economic crisis was small, yet prudent households still lost income.
Few households lost income in the crisis because they were prudent.
answer: The crisis was so big that nearly all households, even careful ones, lost income.
why: 'Such was the scale ... that' = 'so large that'; 'few escaped some loss' = 'almost every household lost some income'.
wrong: Kriz küçük denmiş, hedef çok büyük diyor.
Gelir kaybeden hane sayısı tersine çevrilmiş.
tr: Ekonomik krizin ölçeği o kadar büyüktü ki, ne kadar tutumlu olursa olsun az sayıda hane gelir kaybından kurtuldu.
ruleText: Such was + isim + that = o kadar ... ki. few + escaped = çoğu etkilendi.

target: The meeting was postponed owing to the director's illness.
options: The director postponed the meeting after he recovered from his illness.
The meeting went ahead even though the director was ill.
The director fell ill because the meeting was postponed.
The director's illness caused the meeting to be put off.
answer: The director's illness caused the meeting to be put off.
why: 'owing to' = neden belirtir; 'postponed' = 'put off'. Hastalık ertelemeye yol açtı.
wrong: Yönetici iyileştikten sonra kendisi ertelemiş gibi sunulmuş.
Toplantı yapılmış gibi sunulmuş, hedef ertelendi diyor.
tr: Toplantı müdürün hastalığı nedeniyle ertelendi.
ruleText: owing to + isim = neden belirtir. postpone = put off.

target: Most of the students in the class passed the exam.
options: Every single student in the class failed the exam.
The majority of the class succeeded in the exam.
Some of the students in the class took the exam.
Hardly any students in the class passed the exam.
answer: The majority of the class succeeded in the exam.
why: 'Most of' = 'The majority of'; 'passed' = 'succeeded'.
wrong: Sınava girme bilgisi geçme anlamı taşımaz.
tr: Sınıftaki öğrencilerin çoğu sınavı geçti.
ruleText: most of = the majority of. Niceleyiciler (most, hardly any, some) birbirinin yerine geçmez.

target: He suggested that we should leave early to avoid the traffic.
options: He insisted that we should stay late despite the traffic.
He avoided us because we left early in the traffic.
He proposed leaving early so that we could miss the traffic.
He suggested leaving early because the traffic had already ended.
answer: He proposed leaving early so that we could miss the traffic.
why: 'suggested' = 'proposed'; 'to avoid the traffic' = 'so that we could miss the traffic'.
wrong: Geç kalmayı ısrarla önermiş gibi, hedefle çelişir.
Trafik zaten bitmiş denmiş, neden uydurulmuş.
tr: Trafikten kaçınmak için erken çıkmamızı önerdi.
ruleText: suggest = propose. to avoid X = so that we could miss X (amaç).

target: She said that she had been working there for ten years.
options: She said that ten people worked there.
According to her, she had held that job for a decade.
She said that ten years ago she stopped working there.
She said she would start working there in ten years.
answer: According to her, she had held that job for a decade.
why: Dolaylı anlatım: 'had been working for ten years' = 'had held that job for a decade'.
tr: Orada on yıldır çalıştığını söyledi.
ruleText: Dolaylı anlatımda had been V-ing süreyi korur. ten years = a decade.

target: He behaves as if he owned the company.
options: He acts like the owner of the company, although he is not.
He behaves as though he did not want to own the company.
He behaves well because he owns the company.
He owns the company, so he behaves responsibly.
answer: He acts like the owner of the company, although he is not.
why: 'as if + V2' = gerçek olmayan durum; sahip değil ama sahipmiş gibi davranıyor.
wrong: Sahip olmak istemiyormuş gibi, anlam tersine çevrilmiş.
Sahip olduğu için sorumlu davranıyor denmiş.
tr: Şirketin sahibiymiş gibi davranıyor.
ruleText: as if/as though + geçmiş zaman = gerçek dışı karşılaştırma (sahip değil).

target: I wish I had taken the job offer last year.
options: I hope to take the job offer next year.
I regret not accepting the job offer last year.
I wish I could refuse the job offer next year.
I am happy that I accepted the job offer last year.
answer: I regret not accepting the job offer last year.
why: 'wish + had V3' = geçmişteki bir şey için pişmanlık; teklifi kabul etmedi.
wrong: Kabul ettiği ve mutlu olduğu söylenmiş.
tr: Keşke geçen yıl iş teklifini kabul etseydim.
ruleText: wish + had V3 = pişmanlık (geçmişi değiştiremiyoruz).

target: The report, which was written by an expert, contains several errors.
options: An expert is the author of the report, which includes several mistakes.
The expert who wrote the report corrected several errors.
The report contains errors because it was not written by an expert.
Several experts wrote the report, which has no errors.
answer: An expert is the author of the report, which includes several mistakes.
why: Edilgen cümle etkene çevrilmiş: 'was written by an expert' = 'An expert is the author'.
wrong: Uzman yazmadığı için hata var denmiş, hedef uzman yazdı diyor.
tr: Bir uzman tarafından yazılan rapor birkaç hata içeriyor.
ruleText: Tanımlayıcı olmayan which cümleciği bilgi ekler; edilgen ↔ etken dönüşümü anlamı korur.

target: She had her car repaired last week.
options: She repaired her car herself last week.
Her car was damaged by her last week.
Someone repaired her car for her last week.
She repaired someone else's car last week.
answer: Someone repaired her car for her last week.
why: 'have + nesne + V3' = ettirgen: eylemi başkası yaptı.
tr: Geçen hafta arabasını tamir ettirdi.
ruleText: have + nesne + V3 = ettirgen (başkası yapar).

target: Not being familiar with the procedure, the new employees were reluctant to take any decisions without consulting their supervisor.
options: As they did not know the procedure, the newcomers hesitated to act without their supervisor's advice.
The new employees knew the procedure well and therefore consulted their supervisor.
The new employees took decisions quickly because they did not want to consult anyone.
The supervisor was unfamiliar with the procedure, so the employees took decisions alone.
answer: As they did not know the procedure, the newcomers hesitated to act without their supervisor's advice.
why: 'Not being familiar' = 'Since ... did not know'; 'without consulting' = 'unless they had asked'.
wrong: Prosedürü iyi bildikleri söylenmiş, hedef tanımadıklarını diyor.
Karar hızlı alınmış, hedef çekindiklerini söylüyor.
tr: Prosedüre aşina olmadıkları için yeni çalışanlar amirlerine danışmadan karar vermekten çekindi.
ruleText: Not + V-ing ile başlayan zarf cümleciği sebep bildirir. without + V-ing = unless ... .

target: The extent to which tourism benefits local communities depends less on the number of visitors than on how the revenue is distributed.
options: Tourism benefits local communities more when the number of visitors is larger than the revenue.
The number of visitors depends on how the revenue is distributed among local communities.
How tourism money is shared matters more for local communities than how many people visit.
Local communities benefit from tourism only if revenue is not distributed at all.
answer: How tourism money is shared matters more for local communities than how many people visit.
why: 'depends less on X than on Y' = 'Y matters more than X'.
tr: Turizmin yerel topluluklara sağladığı yarar, ziyaretçi sayısından çok gelirin nasıl paylaşıldığına bağlıdır.
ruleText: depends less on X than on Y = Y, X'ten daha belirleyicidir.

target: Regular exercise reduces the risk of heart disease.
options: Heart disease makes regular exercise more likely.
Heart disease is a risk only for people who exercise.
Regular exercise increases the risk of heart disease.
Exercising regularly makes heart disease less likely.
answer: Exercising regularly makes heart disease less likely.
why: 'reduces the risk' = 'makes ... less likely'.
tr: Düzenli egzersiz kalp hastalığı riskini azaltır.
ruleText: reduce the risk = make less likely. Risk yönü (azalma/artma) değişmemeli.

target: This clinic provides free treatment for children under five.
options: Children below the age of five are treated at this clinic at no cost.
Children under five must pay to be treated at this clinic.
Children above five are treated here free of charge.
This clinic treats only the parents of children under five.
answer: Children below the age of five are treated at this clinic at no cost.
why: 'free treatment' = 'at no cost'; 'under five' = 'below the age of five'.
tr: Bu klinik beş yaşından küçük çocuklara ücretsiz tedavi sağlar.
ruleText: free = at no cost. under = below.

target: He was told to rest for at least two weeks.
options: He was told he could return to work within two weeks.
He was told to rest for at most two weeks.
He told the doctor to rest for two weeks.
The doctor advised him to take a minimum of two weeks' rest.
answer: The doctor advised him to take a minimum of two weeks' rest.
why: 'told to rest' = 'advised to take rest'; 'at least' = 'a minimum of'.
wrong: 'at most' üst sınırı gösterir, hedef alt sınır.
tr: Ona en az iki hafta dinlenmesi söylendi.
ruleText: at least = a minimum of (alt sınır). at most = üst sınır.

target: Smoking is said to be responsible for more deaths than any other preventable cause.
options: Smoking is said to prevent more deaths than other causes.
More deaths are prevented by smoking than by any other cause.
Smoking is the only preventable cause of death, it is said.
Smoking causes more preventable deaths than anything else, according to reports.
answer: Smoking causes more preventable deaths than anything else, according to reports.
why: 'is said to be responsible for' = 'causes ... according to reports'. Üstünlük karşılaştırması korunuyor.
tr: Sigaranın, önlenebilir diğer nedenlerden daha fazla ölümden sorumlu olduğu söylenir.
ruleText: is said to be = ...olduğu söylenir. more ... than any other = en çok.

target: The patients were examined one by one, so as not to cause unnecessary anxiety.
options: Unnecessary anxiety was caused when the patients were examined one by one.
The patients were examined individually because they were already anxious.
The patients were examined all together in order to cause anxiety.
To avoid worrying them needlessly, the doctors examined the patients individually.
answer: To avoid worrying them needlessly, the doctors examined the patients individually.
why: 'so as not to cause anxiety' = 'to avoid worrying them'; 'one by one' = 'individually'.
wrong: Toplu muayene ve kaygı yaratma amacı hedefle çelişir.
tr: Hastalar gereksiz kaygıya yol açmamak için tek tek muayene edildi.
ruleText: so as not to = to avoid. one by one = individually.

target: Not a single patient complained about the new system.
options: No patient was allowed to use the new system.
None of the patients made any complaint about the new system.
A single patient complained about the new system.
Most patients complained about the new system.
answer: None of the patients made any complaint about the new system.
why: 'Not a single' = 'None of'.
tr: Hiçbir hasta yeni sistemden şikâyet etmedi.
ruleText: not a single = none of = hiç biri.

target: He had barely recovered from the flu when he caught a cold.
options: He caught a cold before he had flu.
He recovered from the flu completely before he caught a cold two months later.
He caught a cold soon after he had got over the flu.
He recovered from the flu because he caught a cold.
answer: He caught a cold soon after he had got over the flu.
why: 'barely ... when' = 'soon after'. Grip bitince hemen nezle.
tr: Gripten zar zor iyileşmişti ki nezle oldu.
ruleText: barely + had V3 + when = hemen ardından.

target: The treatment is expected to be available to all citizens by 2030.
options: Citizens expect the treatment to be unavailable in 2030.
The treatment was available to all citizens until 2030.
Only some citizens will be able to receive the treatment after 2030.
By 2030, it is anticipated that every citizen will have access to the treatment.
answer: By 2030, it is anticipated that every citizen will have access to the treatment.
why: 'is expected to be available to all' = 'it is anticipated that every citizen will have access'.
tr: Tedavinin 2030'a kadar tüm vatandaşlar için erişilebilir olması bekleniyor.
ruleText: is expected to V = it is anticipated that ... will ... . all = every.

target: Whatever the benefits of the new screening programme may be, they will be of little use unless people can be persuaded to attend.
options: People will attend the screening programme because its benefits are so great.
However useful screening is, it achieves little unless people are encouraged to attend.
The benefits of the screening programme are small, even if people attend.
The screening programme will be useful only if people refuse to attend.
answer: However useful screening is, it achieves little unless people are encouraged to attend.
why: 'Whatever the benefits' = 'No matter how useful'; 'unless ... persuaded' = 'if ... cannot be encouraged'.
wrong: Fayda küçük denmiş, hedefte fayda katılıma bağlı.
tr: Yeni tarama programının yararları ne olursa olsun, insanlar katılmaya ikna edilmedikçe pek işe yaramaz.
ruleText: Whatever/No matter how = ne olursa olsun. unless = if ... not.

target: Far more attention has been paid to the treatment of illness than to its prevention, notwithstanding the evidence that prevention is cheaper.
options: Prevention has received more attention than treatment because it is cheaper.
Treatment and prevention have received equal attention, since prevention costs less.
Although prevention is shown to cost less, treatment has received much more attention than prevention.
The evidence shows that treatment is cheaper, but prevention has received more attention.
answer: Although prevention is shown to cost less, treatment has received much more attention than prevention.
why: 'notwithstanding' = 'Although/despite'; 'far more attention ... than' = 'much more attention than'.
wrong: Yön ters: önleme daha çok ilgi görmüş.
Maliyet ve ilgi yönü ters çevrilmiş.
tr: Önlemenin daha ucuz olduğuna dair kanıtlara rağmen hastalığın tedavisine önlenmesinden çok daha fazla önem verilmiştir.
ruleText: notwithstanding = despite. far more ... than = çok daha fazla.

target: The Earth takes one year to travel around the Sun.
options: The Earth travels around the Sun in a month.
The Earth travels around the Sun only once every ten years.
It takes a year for the Earth to orbit the Sun.
The Sun takes a year to travel around the Earth.
answer: It takes a year for the Earth to orbit the Sun.
why: 'travel around' = 'orbit'; süre korunuyor.
tr: Dünya'nın Güneş'in etrafında dolanması bir yıl sürer.
ruleText: take + süre + to V = ...bir süre alır. travel around = orbit.

target: Metals expand when they are heated.
options: Metals shrink when they are heated.
Heating causes metals to increase in size.
Metals are heated when they expand.
Metals expand only when they are cooled.
answer: Heating causes metals to increase in size.
why: 'expand when heated' = 'heating causes ... to increase in size'.
tr: Metaller ısıtıldığında genleşir.
ruleText: expand = increase in size. when + edilgen = ...nın etkisiyle.

target: The substance is so unstable that it must be stored at low temperatures.
options: The substance becomes unstable because it is stored at low temperatures.
The substance is stable enough to be stored at any temperature.
Because the substance is highly unstable, it has to be kept cold.
The substance must be heated because it is unstable.
answer: Because the substance is highly unstable, it has to be kept cold.
why: 'so ... that' = sonuç; 'must be stored at low temperatures' = 'has to be kept cold'.
tr: Madde o kadar kararsızdır ki düşük sıcaklıkta saklanmalıdır.
ruleText: so + sıfat + that = çok ... olduğu için. must = has to.

target: Neither the first nor the second experiment produced conclusive results.
options: Both experiments failed to produce conclusive results.
The first experiment was conclusive, but the second one was not.
Both experiments produced conclusive results.
Only one of the experiments produced conclusive results.
answer: Both experiments failed to produce conclusive results.
why: 'Neither ... nor' = 'Both ... failed'.
wrong: İkisinin de kesin sonuç verdiği söylenmiş.
tr: Ne birinci ne de ikinci deney kesin sonuç verdi.
ruleText: neither ... nor = ikisi de değil (both ... not).

target: The volcano is thought to have erupted several times in the past.
options: It is believed that the volcano has had several eruptions before.
Several volcanoes are thought to have erupted once in the past.
The volcano will probably erupt several times in the future.
The volcano is thought to be erupting now.
answer: It is believed that the volcano has had several eruptions before.
why: 'is thought to have erupted' = 'it is believed that ... has had eruptions'.
wrong: Birden fazla yanardağ, bir kez püskürme denmiş.
tr: Yanardağın geçmişte birkaç kez püskürdüğü düşünülüyor.
ruleText: is thought to have V3 = geçmişte olduğu düşünülüyor.

target: Unlike mammals, reptiles cannot regulate their body temperature internally.
options: Mammals can regulate their body temperature internally, whereas reptiles cannot.
Mammals cannot regulate their body temperature internally, unlike reptiles.
Reptiles regulate their body temperature more effectively than mammals do.
Both mammals and reptiles regulate their body temperature internally.
answer: Mammals can regulate their body temperature internally, whereas reptiles cannot.
why: 'Unlike' = 'whereas'. Memeliler düzenler, sürüngenler düzenleyemez.
tr: Memelilerin aksine sürüngenler vücut ısılarını içeriden düzenleyemez.
ruleText: Unlike A, B = A ... whereas B ... . Roller değişmemeli.

target: As the altitude increases, the amount of oxygen available decreases.
options: The higher you climb, the more oxygen there is.
The lower the altitude, the less oxygen is available.
Oxygen increases because the altitude decreases.
The higher you climb, the less oxygen there is.
answer: The higher you climb, the less oxygen there is.
why: 'altitude increases, oxygen decreases' = 'the higher, the less oxygen'.
wrong: Hem oksijen hem rakım yönü ters.
tr: Rakım arttıkça mevcut oksijen miktarı azalır.
ruleText: As + artış, azalış = the + comp, the + comp.

target: The data, though limited in scope, lend considerable support to the hypothesis that the species migrated southward in response to climatic cooling.
options: The species migrated south because the data supported the hypothesis.
Climatic cooling occurred because the species migrated southward.
The data are so extensive that they disprove the hypothesis of southward migration.
Though limited, the evidence strongly suggests cooling drove the species south.
answer: Though limited, the evidence strongly suggests cooling drove the species south.
why: 'though limited' = 'Despite covering little ground'; 'lend considerable support' = 'strongly suggests'.
wrong: Neden-sonuç ters: veri göçe neden olmuş.
Veri geniş denmiş, hipotezi çürütüyor denmiş.
tr: Veriler kapsam bakımından sınırlı olsa da türün iklim soğumasına tepki olarak güneye göç ettiği hipotezini önemli ölçüde destekliyor.
ruleText: though + sıfat = despite. lend support to = destekler.

target: Rather than being a single event, the extinction is now regarded as a series of crises spread over several million years.
options: The extinction was once thought to be a series of crises, but is now regarded as a single event.
Scientists now see the extinction as a sequence of crises over millions of years, not one event.
Several million years passed before scientists regarded the extinction as a series of crises.
The extinction is regarded as a single sudden crisis, not a long series.
answer: Scientists now see the extinction as a sequence of crises over millions of years, not one event.
why: 'Rather than being a single event' = 'not one event'; 'is regarded as a series of crises' = 'see as a sequence of crises'.
wrong: Eski ve yeni görüş yer değiştirmiş.
tr: Tek bir olay olmaktan çok, yok oluş artık birkaç milyon yıla yayılan bir krizler dizisi olarak görülüyor.
ruleText: rather than + isim = ...yerine/...değil. be regarded as = ...olarak görülür.

target: Only by comparing samples from several sites can researchers determine whether the contamination is local or widespread.
options: The contamination is local only when researchers compare samples from several sites.
Researchers can tell if the contamination is local or widespread solely by comparing samples from various sites.
Researchers compare samples from several sites because they already know the contamination is widespread.
Comparing samples from several sites is unnecessary for determining whether contamination is local.
answer: Researchers can tell if the contamination is local or widespread solely by comparing samples from various sites.
why: 'Only by comparing ... can researchers determine' = 'can tell ... solely by comparing'.
tr: Araştırmacılar kirliliğin yerel mi yaygın mı olduğunu ancak birkaç noktadan alınan örnekleri karşılaştırarak belirleyebilir.
ruleText: Only by + V-ing + yardımcı fiil + özne = ancak ... ile. determine = tell.

target: The new bridge will make it easier for people to commute to work.
options: The new bridge will make it harder for people to commute.
Commuting will be simpler for people because of the new bridge.
People will build the new bridge so that commuting is easier.
The new bridge will be used only by people who do not commute.
answer: Commuting will be simpler for people because of the new bridge.
why: 'make it easier' = 'will be simpler because of'.
wrong: Köprüyü yalnızca işe gitmeyenler kullanıyor denmiş.
tr: Yeni köprü insanların işe gidip gelmesini kolaylaştıracak.
ruleText: make it easier = simpler. Neden köprü, sonuç kolaylık.

target: Local authorities are responsible for maintaining public parks.
options: Public parks are responsible for maintaining local authorities.
Local authorities are not allowed to maintain public parks.
Public parks are looked after by local authorities.
Public parks are looked after by the people who live nearby.
answer: Public parks are looked after by local authorities.
why: 'responsible for maintaining' = 'looked after by'. Etken → edilgen.
tr: Kamu parklarının bakımından yerel yönetimler sorumludur.
ruleText: responsible for maintaining = look after (edilgen).

target: He is by no means the first leader to face such criticism.
options: He is the only leader who has never faced criticism.
Many other leaders have faced similar criticism before him.
He is the first leader to face such criticism.
No leader has ever faced such criticism except him.
answer: Many other leaders have faced similar criticism before him.
why: 'by no means the first' = 'Many others before him'.
tr: Böyle bir eleştiriyle karşılaşan ilk lider kesinlikle o değil.
ruleText: by no means = hiçbir şekilde, asla. not the first = ondan önce de oldu.

target: The proposal was rejected on the grounds that it was too expensive.
options: The proposal was rejected, but not because of the cost.
The proposal was expensive because it was rejected.
Because of its high cost, the proposal was turned down.
The proposal was accepted although it was too expensive.
answer: Because of its high cost, the proposal was turned down.
why: 'on the grounds that' = 'because'; 'rejected' = 'turned down'.
tr: Öneri çok pahalı olduğu gerekçesiyle reddedildi.
ruleText: on the grounds that = because. reject = turn down.

target: In contrast to previous generations, young people today tend to marry later.
options: Young people today rarely marry, unlike previous generations who always did.
Young people today marry earlier than previous generations did.
Young people today and previous generations marry at the same age.
Earlier generations tended to marry younger than today's young people do.
answer: Earlier generations tended to marry younger than today's young people do.
why: 'later' = 'daha ileri yaşta'; önceki kuşaklar daha erken evleniyordu.
tr: Önceki kuşakların aksine bugünün gençleri daha geç evlenme eğiliminde.
ruleText: In contrast to = ...in aksine. marry later = daha geç yaşta evlenir.

target: It is widely assumed that wealthier societies are happier, but this is not always the case.
options: Many people think rich societies are happier, but that is not necessarily true.
Poor societies are assumed to be happier, and that is always true.
It is not widely assumed that wealthier societies are happy at all.
Everyone knows that rich societies are always happier.
answer: Many people think rich societies are happier, but that is not necessarily true.
why: 'widely assumed' = 'many think'; 'not always the case' = 'not necessarily true'.
tr: Daha zengin toplumların daha mutlu olduğu yaygın olarak varsayılır, ama bu her zaman doğru değildir.
ruleText: widely assumed = many think. not always = not necessarily.

target: Apart from a few minor changes, the plan remained as it was.
options: Except for some small alterations, the plan stayed the same.
The plan was changed completely, apart from a few minor changes.
A few minor changes were added to the plan, which was then completely rewritten.
The plan remained as it was, apart from a few major changes.
answer: Except for some small alterations, the plan stayed the same.
why: 'Apart from' = 'Except for'; 'minor changes' = 'small alterations'.
tr: Birkaç küçük değişiklik dışında plan olduğu gibi kaldı.
ruleText: apart from = except for. minor = small.

target: It is not so much the cost of housing as the lack of available land that prevents the city from expanding.
options: The shortage of land, rather than housing prices, is what holds back the city's growth.
Housing costs, more than the shortage of land, prevent the city from expanding.
Neither the cost of housing nor the lack of land affects the city's expansion.
The city expands because land is available and housing is cheap.
answer: The shortage of land, rather than housing prices, is what holds back the city's growth.
why: 'not so much A as B' = 'B rather than A'.
wrong: Vurgu ters: konut maliyeti daha belirleyici gösterilmiş.
tr: Şehrin genişlemesini engelleyen, konut maliyetinden çok arazi yetersizliğidir.
ruleText: not so much A as B = A'dan çok B.

target: The more governments restrict the flow of information, the less likely citizens are to trust official statements.
options: Citizens' distrust of official statements makes governments loosen control over information.
Governments control information more tightly when citizens believe official statements.
Tighter government control over information makes citizens more inclined to believe official statements.
Tighter government control over information makes citizens less inclined to believe official statements.
answer: Tighter government control over information makes citizens less inclined to believe official statements.
why: 'The more restrict, the less likely to trust' = 'tighter control makes less inclined to believe'.
tr: Hükümetler bilgi akışını ne kadar kısıtlarsa vatandaşlar resmî açıklamalara o kadar az güvenir.
ruleText: the more ..., the less likely = kısıtlama arttıkça güven azalır. Neden hükümet, sonuç vatandaş.

target: Despite his having been warned repeatedly, the minister continued to dismiss the concerns of his advisers as exaggerated.
options: The advisers dismissed the minister's concerns because they had been warned repeatedly.
Since he had not been warned, the minister dismissed the concerns of his advisers as exaggerated.
The minister kept waving away his advisers' worries as overstated, even though he had been cautioned many times.
The minister stopped ignoring his advisers' concerns after he had been warned repeatedly.
answer: The minister kept waving away his advisers' worries as overstated, even though he had been cautioned many times.
why: 'Despite having been warned' = 'even though he had been cautioned'; 'dismiss as exaggerated' = 'wave away as overstated'.
tr: Defalarca uyarılmasına rağmen bakan, danışmanlarının kaygılarını abartılı diyerek geçiştirmeye devam etti.
ruleText: Despite + (his) having V3 = even though. dismiss as exaggerated = wave away as overstated.

target: You may borrow the book as long as you return it by Monday.
options: You can borrow the book provided that you give it back no later than Monday.
You may borrow the book only after you return it on Monday.
You may keep the book for as long as you like after Monday.
You cannot borrow the book unless you return it after Monday.
answer: You can borrow the book provided that you give it back no later than Monday.
why: 'as long as' = 'provided that'; 'by Monday' = 'no later than Monday'.
wrong: Pazartesi'den sonra istediği kadar tutabilir denmiş.
tr: Kitabı Pazartesi gününe kadar iade ettiğin sürece ödünç alabilirsin.
ruleText: as long as = provided that (koşul). by = en geç.

target: I would rather stay at home than go out tonight.
options: I prefer going out tonight to staying at home.
I prefer staying at home to going out tonight.
I would like to go out tonight rather than stay at home.
I have to stay at home because I cannot go out tonight.
answer: I prefer staying at home to going out tonight.
why: 'would rather A than B' = 'prefer A to B'.
tr: Bu gece dışarı çıkmaktansa evde kalmayı tercih ederim.
ruleText: would rather A than B = prefer A to B. Tercih edilen A'dır.

target: It is no use complaining about the noise.
options: There is no point in complaining about the noise.
Complaining about the noise is very useful.
People complain about the noise because it is of no use.
The noise is of no use to people who complain.
answer: There is no point in complaining about the noise.
why: 'It is no use V-ing' = 'There is no point in V-ing'.
tr: Gürültüden şikâyet etmenin faydası yok.
ruleText: It is no use + V-ing = There is no point in + V-ing (boşuna).

target: You should have told me about the problem earlier.
options: You must tell me about the problem sooner next time.
You were not able to tell me about the problem earlier.
It was a mistake not to inform me of the problem sooner.
You told me about the problem earlier than you should have.
answer: It was a mistake not to inform me of the problem sooner.
why: 'should have V3' = geçmişte yapılması gerekirdi ama yapılmadı.
tr: Bana sorunu daha önce söylemeliydin.
ruleText: should have + V3 = yapılmadı, yapılmalıydı (eleştiri/pişmanlık).

target: They needn't have hurried; the train was delayed.
options: The train was delayed because they hurried.
They did not hurry, so the train was delayed.
Hurrying was unnecessary because the train was late.
They had to hurry because the train was delayed.
answer: Hurrying was unnecessary because the train was late.
why: 'needn't have V3' = acele ettiler ama gerekmiyordu.
tr: Acele etmelerine gerek yoktu; tren rötar yaptı.
ruleText: needn't have + V3 = yaptı ama gereksizdi.

target: The new model is nowhere near as reliable as the old one.
options: The old model is slightly less reliable than the new one.
The new and old models are equally reliable.
The new model is much more reliable than the old one.
The old model is far more reliable than the new one.
answer: The old model is far more reliable than the new one.
why: 'nowhere near as reliable as' = eski model çok daha güvenilir.
wrong: Fark yön olarak ters ve küçük.
tr: Yeni model eskisi kadar güvenilir olmaktan çok uzak.
ruleText: nowhere near as ... as = ...'dan çok daha az (büyük fark).

target: She came up with a solution just before the deadline.
options: She thought of a solution shortly before the deadline.
She came up to the deadline with no solution.
She rejected the solution just before the deadline.
She found the deadline before she had a solution.
answer: She thought of a solution shortly before the deadline.
why: 'came up with' = 'thought of'; 'just before' = 'shortly before'.
wrong: Son tarih bulmak gibi anlam kayması.
tr: Son teslim tarihinden hemen önce bir çözüm buldu.
ruleText: come up with = think of/produce (fikir bulmak).

target: The company is on the verge of bankruptcy.
options: The company plans to go bankrupt soon on purpose.
The company has just escaped bankruptcy.
The company has already gone bankrupt.
The company is very close to going bankrupt.
answer: The company is very close to going bankrupt.
why: 'on the verge of' = 'very close to'.
tr: Şirket iflasın eşiğinde.
ruleText: on the verge of = çok yakın (henüz olmadı).

target: Hardly any of the findings, however carefully presented, were accepted by the committee without serious reservations.
options: The committee accepted all the findings as they were carefully presented.
Serious reservations were raised only about the carefully presented findings.
The committee accepted a few findings because they were carefully presented.
The committee accepted almost none of the findings unconditionally, however well they were presented.
answer: The committee accepted almost none of the findings unconditionally, however well they were presented.
why: 'Hardly any' = 'almost none'; 'without serious reservations' = 'unconditionally'.
tr: Ne kadar özenle sunulursa sunulsun bulguların neredeyse hiçbiri komite tarafından ciddi çekinceler olmaksızın kabul edilmedi.
ruleText: hardly any = almost none. however + sıfat = ne kadar ... olursa olsun.

target: Granted that the plan has its drawbacks, it is still preferable to doing nothing at all.
options: Because the plan has drawbacks, doing nothing is preferable.
While the plan is not perfect, taking no action would be an even worse choice.
Doing nothing at all is acceptable, as the plan has no drawbacks.
The plan's drawbacks are so serious that it should not be tried.
answer: While the plan is not perfect, taking no action would be an even worse choice.
why: 'Granted that' = 'While ... is not perfect'; 'preferable to doing nothing' = 'doing nothing would be worse'.
wrong: Kusur yüzünden hiçbir şey yapmamak tercih edilmiş.
tr: Planın kusurları olduğu kabul edilse de hiçbir şey yapmamaktan yine de yeğdir.
ruleText: Granted that = ...olduğunu kabul etsek de. preferable to = ...e tercih edilir.

target: Patients are not allowed to eat or drink before the operation.
options: Eating and drinking are forbidden for patients prior to the operation.
Patients may eat or drink during the operation.
Patients must eat and drink before the operation.
Patients are allowed to drink but not eat after the operation.
answer: Eating and drinking are forbidden for patients prior to the operation.
why: 'not allowed' = 'forbidden'; 'before' = 'prior to'.
tr: Hastaların ameliyattan önce yemesine ve içmesine izin verilmez.
ruleText: not allowed = forbidden. before = prior to.

target: Both the doctor and the nurse agreed with the plan.
options: Only the doctor agreed with the plan, while the nurse did not.
The doctor and the nurse disagreed about the plan.
The doctor and the nurse alike approved of the plan.
Neither the doctor nor the nurse agreed with the plan.
answer: The doctor and the nurse alike approved of the plan.
why: 'Both ... and' = 'alike'; 'agreed with' = 'approved of'.
tr: Hem doktor hem de hemşire plana katıldı.
ruleText: both A and B = A and B alike. İkisi de aynı yönde.

target: He is accustomed to working night shifts.
options: He is not used to working night shifts.
He refuses to work night shifts.
He has got used to working during the night.
He used to work night shifts, but not any longer.
answer: He has got used to working during the night.
why: 'is accustomed to' = 'has got used to'.
tr: Gece vardiyalarında çalışmaya alışkın.
ruleText: be accustomed to + V-ing = be/get used to + V-ing (alışkın).

target: You had better see a doctor if the pain continues.
options: The pain continues because you did not see a doctor.
It would be wise to consult a doctor if the pain does not stop.
You may see a doctor only after the pain stops.
You should see a doctor even if the pain stops.
answer: It would be wise to consult a doctor if the pain does not stop.
why: 'had better' = 'it would be wise to'; 'continues' = 'does not stop'.
tr: Ağrı devam ederse bir doktora görünsen iyi olur.
ruleText: had better = ...sen iyi olur (güçlü tavsiye).

target: The drug can't have caused the rash, since he had never taken it.
options: It is impossible that the drug caused the rash, as he had never taken it.
He never took the drug because it caused the rash.
The drug may have caused the rash, but he never took it.
The rash was caused by the drug he had never taken.
answer: It is impossible that the drug caused the rash, as he had never taken it.
why: 'can't have V3' = geçmişte imkânsız.
tr: Hiç almamış olduğu için ilaç döküntüye neden olmuş olamaz.
ruleText: can't have + V3 = geçmiş hakkında olumsuz çıkarım (kesinlikle olmadı).

target: Regardless of age, everybody can benefit from regular exercise.
options: Regular exercise benefits people more when they are older.
Whatever one's age, regular exercise is beneficial for all.
Age is the most important factor in benefiting from exercise.
Only the old can benefit from regular exercise.
answer: Whatever one's age, regular exercise is beneficial for all.
why: 'Regardless of age' = 'Whatever one's age'; 'can benefit' = 'is beneficial'.
tr: Yaş fark etmeksizin herkes düzenli egzersizden yarar sağlayabilir.
ruleText: regardless of = ...e bakılmaksızın. Yaş bir etken değil, engel değil.

target: The hospital has expanded its services in terms of both staff and equipment.
options: The hospital has expanded its services without staff or equipment.
The hospital has reduced both its staff and equipment.
The hospital has expanded its staff but not its equipment.
The hospital now has more staff as well as more equipment.
answer: The hospital now has more staff as well as more equipment.
why: 'in terms of both staff and equipment' = 'more staff as well as more equipment'.
tr: Hastane hizmetlerini hem personel hem de donanım açısından genişletti.
ruleText: in terms of both A and B = hem A hem B bakımından.

target: He failed to recognise the symptoms until it was too late.
options: He recognised the symptoms but it was already too late.
He recognised the symptoms only after he had been cured.
He did not notice the symptoms in time.
He recognised the symptoms in plenty of time.
answer: He did not notice the symptoms in time.
why: 'failed to recognise until too late' = 'did not notice in time'.
wrong: Fark etmiş ama geç kalmış denmiş; hedef fark edemedi diyor.
tr: Belirtileri çok geç olana kadar fark edemedi.
ruleText: fail to V = V edememek. until too late = zamanında değil.

target: It is a commonplace that the strength of a health system is measured not by how it treats the wealthy, but by how well it protects the poorest.
options: Health systems are strongest when they protect the wealthy before the poor.
People often say that a health system should be judged by its care for the poorest, rather than the richest.
It is rarely said that a health system is measured by its care for the poorest.
A health system is measured by how it treats the wealthy, and the poorest are protected equally.
answer: People often say that a health system should be judged by its care for the poorest, rather than the richest.
why: 'commonplace' = 'often say'; 'not by X but by Y' = 'Y rather than X'.
tr: Bir sağlık sisteminin gücünün zenginlere nasıl davrandığıyla değil, en yoksulları ne kadar koruduğuyla ölçüldüğü sıkça söylenir.
ruleText: not by X but by Y = X değil Y ile. commonplace = sık söylenen söz.

target: Little as we know about the long-term effects of the drug, early evidence points to benefits that outweigh the risks.
options: We know so much about the long-term effects that the risks clearly exceed the benefits.
Though long-term effects are poorly known, early evidence suggests the benefits exceed the risks.
The drug's benefits are small, as early evidence shows risks outweighing them.
Because early evidence is limited, little is known about long-term effects.
answer: Though long-term effects are poorly known, early evidence suggests the benefits exceed the risks.
why: 'Little as we know' = 'Although our knowledge is limited'; 'outweigh' = 'exceed'.
wrong: Çok şey biliniyor denmiş ve risk fazla denmiş.
tr: İlacın uzun vadeli etkileri hakkında az şey bilsek de ilk kanıtlar yararların risklerden ağır bastığını gösteriyor.
ruleText: Little as we know = az bilsek de (Although). outweigh = ağır basmak.

target: The experiment must be repeated in case the results are wrong.
options: The results are wrong because the experiment was repeated.
The experiment must be repeated because the results are definitely right.
We should repeat the experiment as a precaution against incorrect results.
The experiment should not be repeated even if the results are wrong.
answer: We should repeat the experiment as a precaution against incorrect results.
why: 'in case' = önlem olarak; 'wrong' = 'incorrect'.
tr: Sonuçlar yanlış çıkmasın diye deney tekrarlanmalı.
ruleText: in case + cümle = ...olabilir diye (önlem).

target: Light travels much faster than sound.
options: Sound travels much more slowly than light.
Light and sound travel at the same speed.
Light travels slightly faster than sound.
Sound travels much faster than light.
answer: Sound travels much more slowly than light.
why: Karşılaştırma ters çevrilmiş ama anlam aynı: ışık çok hızlı, ses çok yavaş.
tr: Işık sesten çok daha hızlı yol alır.
ruleText: A is much faster than B = B is much slower than A.

target: The lake has been getting smaller for decades owing to excessive irrigation.
options: Excessive irrigation has been reduced because the lake is shrinking.
Over-irrigation has caused the lake to shrink over many decades.
The lake got smaller after decades without irrigation.
The lake has grown for decades because of excessive irrigation.
answer: Over-irrigation has caused the lake to shrink over many decades.
why: 'getting smaller' = 'shrink'; 'excessive irrigation' = 'over-irrigation'.
tr: Göl, aşırı sulama yüzünden onlarca yıldır küçülüyor.
ruleText: get smaller = shrink. owing to = caused by.

target: Whoever discovers the cause of the disease will receive the prize.
options: The prize will go to anyone who finds out what causes the disease.
The disease will be caused by whoever wins the prize.
Nobody will receive the prize for discovering the disease's cause.
Whoever receives the prize will discover the cause of the disease.
answer: The prize will go to anyone who finds out what causes the disease.
why: 'Whoever' = 'anyone who'; 'discovers the cause' = 'finds out what causes'.
tr: Hastalığın nedenini keşfeden kişi ödülü alacak.
ruleText: whoever = anyone who. Keşif önce, ödül sonra.

target: The planet's surface temperature is, on average, twice as high as Earth's.
options: Earth is twice as hot as the planet on average.
The planet is half as hot as Earth on average.
On average, the planet is twice as hot as Earth at its surface.
The planet is slightly hotter than Earth on average.
answer: On average, the planet is twice as hot as Earth at its surface.
why: 'twice as high as' = 'twice as hot as'.
tr: Gezegenin yüzey sıcaklığı ortalama olarak Dünya'nınkinin iki katıdır.
ruleText: twice as + sıfat + as = iki katı. Karşılaştırmada roller değişmemeli.

target: On condition that the temperature remains constant, the pressure will not change.
options: The temperature remains constant only when the pressure changes.
The pressure will not change unless the temperature stays constant.
The pressure will stay the same, but only if the temperature does not vary.
If the temperature changes, the pressure will remain the same.
answer: The pressure will stay the same, but only if the temperature does not vary.
why: 'On condition that' = 'only if'.
wrong: Sıcaklık değişince basınç sabit kalır denmiş.
tr: Sıcaklık sabit kalmak koşuluyla basınç değişmeyecektir.
ruleText: on condition that = only if (koşul).

target: The scientists are about to announce the results.
options: The scientists refuse to announce the results.
The scientists will shortly make the results public.
The scientists are about to begin the experiments.
The scientists announced the results some time ago.
answer: The scientists will shortly make the results public.
why: 'are about to announce' = 'will shortly make public'.
tr: Bilim insanları sonuçları açıklamak üzere.
ruleText: be about to V = çok yakında V edecek.

target: Whatever the precise mechanism may turn out to be, the observed correlation between the two variables is too strong to be dismissed as coincidence.
options: Because the mechanism is unknown, the correlation is considered coincidence.
The correlation is weak, whatever the mechanism may be.
The exact mechanism is known, and the correlation is dismissed as coincidence.
Whatever the exact process, the link between the two variables is too strong to be mere chance.
answer: Whatever the exact process, the link between the two variables is too strong to be mere chance.
why: 'Whatever the precise mechanism' = 'Regardless of the exact process'; 'too strong to be dismissed' = 'too strong to be explained by chance'.
wrong: Mekanizma biliniyor ve rastlantı sayılıyor denmiş.
tr: Kesin mekanizma ne çıkarsa çıksın iki değişken arasında gözlenen ilişki tesadüf diye geçiştirilemeyecek kadar güçlüdür.
ruleText: Whatever ... may turn out to be = ne olursa olsun. too strong to be + V3 = ...edilemeyecek kadar güçlü.

target: Scientists have long been puzzled by the fact that the universe appears to be expanding at an ever-increasing rate.
options: Researchers have long struggled to explain why the universe expands faster and faster.
The universe appears to expand because scientists have been puzzled.
Scientists have long understood why the universe expands at a decreasing rate.
Scientists were puzzled until they found that the universe stopped expanding.
answer: Researchers have long struggled to explain why the universe expands faster and faster.
why: 'puzzled' = 'found it hard to explain'; 'ever-increasing rate' = 'faster and faster'.
tr: Bilim insanları evrenin sürekli artan bir hızla genişliyor gibi görünmesi karşısında uzun süredir şaşkın.
ruleText: puzzled by = açıklayamamak. ever-increasing = giderek artan (faster and faster).

target: Not until the species had been protected by law did its population show any sign of recovery.
