options: Legal protection was introduced as soon as the species started to recover.
The species was protected by law only after it recovered.
The species began to recover only once legal protection had been introduced.
The species recovered because it had never been protected by law.
answer: The species began to recover only once legal protection had been introduced.
why: 'Not until ... did' = 'only once'. Koruma önce, iyileşme sonra.
tr: Tür yasayla korunana kadar nüfusunda hiçbir toparlanma belirtisi görülmedi.
ruleText: Not until + olay + did + özne = ancak ... olduktan sonra.

target: Both candidates promised to reduce taxes.
options: Neither candidate promised to reduce taxes.
Both candidates promised to raise taxes.
Only one candidate promised to reduce taxes.
Each of the two candidates pledged to cut taxes.
answer: Each of the two candidates pledged to cut taxes.
why: 'Both' = 'Each of the two'; 'promised' = 'pledged'; 'reduce' = 'cut'.
tr: Her iki aday da vergileri düşürmeye söz verdi.
ruleText: both = each of the two. promise = pledge. reduce = cut.

target: The festival attracts visitors from all over the world.
options: The festival attracts visitors only from the local area.
Visitors from all over the world avoid the festival.
The festival is attended by few visitors from abroad.
People travel to the festival from every corner of the globe.
answer: People travel to the festival from every corner of the globe.
why: 'all over the world' = 'every corner of the globe'.
tr: Festival dünyanın her yerinden ziyaretçi çekiyor.
ruleText: all over the world = every corner of the globe.

target: He lost his job, which made it hard for him to pay the rent.
options: He paid the rent easily after losing his job.
He lost his job because he could not pay the rent.
He lost his job and the rent was paid by his employer.
Because he became unemployed, paying the rent was difficult for him.
answer: Because he became unemployed, paying the rent was difficult for him.
why: 'which made it hard' = 'because ... difficult'. İşsizlik sebep, kira zorluğu sonuç.
tr: İşini kaybetti, bu da kirayı ödemesini zorlaştırdı.
ruleText: which = önceki cümlenin tamamına gönderme. made it hard = zorlaştırdı.

target: The mayor refused to comment on the allegations.
options: The mayor commented extensively on the allegations.
The mayor declined to give any statement about the accusations.
The mayor was refused permission to comment on the allegations.
The mayor denied that the allegations had been made.
answer: The mayor declined to give any statement about the accusations.
why: 'refused to comment' = 'declined to give any statement'; 'allegations' = 'accusations'.
tr: Belediye başkanı iddialara ilişkin yorum yapmayı reddetti.
ruleText: refuse = decline. comment on = give a statement about.

target: The new rules are supposed to protect tenants from unfair eviction.
options: The new rules are intended to shield tenants from unjust eviction.
The new rules protect only tenants who have been evicted unfairly.
Tenants are supposed to protect the new rules from eviction.
The new rules are said to cause unfair eviction of tenants.
answer: The new rules are intended to shield tenants from unjust eviction.
why: 'supposed to protect' = 'intended to shield'; 'unfair' = 'unjust'.
tr: Yeni kuralların kiracıları haksız tahliyeden korumaya yönelik olduğu varsayılıyor.
ruleText: be supposed to = be intended to (amaçlanan).

target: Whether or not the proposal is approved, the project will go ahead.
options: The project will be cancelled whether or not the proposal is approved.
The project will proceed regardless of the proposal's approval.
The project will go ahead only if the proposal is approved.
The proposal will be approved because the project will go ahead.
answer: The project will proceed regardless of the proposal's approval.
why: 'Whether or not' = 'regardless of'; 'go ahead' = 'proceed'.
tr: Öneri onaylansın ya da onaylanmasın proje devam edecek.
ruleText: whether or not = regardless of (koşulsuz).

target: Few countries are as dependent on tourism as the Maldives.
options: The Maldives does not depend on tourism, unlike most countries.
Many countries depend on tourism more than the Maldives does.
Only the Maldives depends on tourism.
The Maldives is among the countries most dependent on tourism.
answer: The Maldives is among the countries most dependent on tourism.
why: 'Few ... as dependent as' = 'among the most dependent'.
tr: Çok az ülke turizme Maldivler kadar bağımlıdır.
ruleText: few ... as ... as = en çok ... olanlardan biri.

target: Be that as it may, the government can hardly ignore the mounting evidence that austerity has widened regional inequalities.
options: Regional inequalities have grown, and the government has therefore stopped austerity.
The government easily ignores the evidence that spending cuts have narrowed regional gaps.
Since that is the case, the government ignores the mounting evidence about regional inequalities.
Even so, the government cannot easily disregard the growing proof that spending cuts have increased regional gaps.
answer: Even so, the government cannot easily disregard the growing proof that spending cuts have increased regional gaps.
why: 'Be that as it may' = 'Even so'; 'can hardly ignore' = 'cannot easily disregard'; 'austerity' = 'spending cuts'.
tr: Her şeye rağmen hükümet, kemer sıkmanın bölgesel eşitsizlikleri artırdığına dair artan kanıtları kolayca görmezden gelemez.
ruleText: Be that as it may = öyle de olsa. can hardly V = kolayca V edemez.

target: Contrary to popular opinion, the majority of those who emigrate do so not out of desperation but in pursuit of better opportunities.
options: Most emigrants are desperate because they pursue better opportunities.
A minority of emigrants pursue better opportunities, while the rest are desperate.
Despite popular belief, most emigrants leave seeking better prospects, not out of desperation.
As most people believe, emigrants leave their countries out of desperation.
answer: Despite popular belief, most emigrants leave seeking better prospects, not out of desperation.
why: 'Contrary to popular opinion' = 'Despite what many people believe'; 'not out of A but in pursuit of B' = 'B rather than A'.
tr: Yaygın kanının aksine, göç edenlerin çoğu çaresizlikten değil, daha iyi fırsatlar peşinde göç eder.
ruleText: Contrary to popular opinion = yaygın kanının aksine. not out of A but in pursuit of B = B için, A'dan değil.

target: That the reforms have been only partly successful is hardly surprising, given that they were introduced with little public consultation.
options: It is not surprising that the reforms have had limited success, as there was scarcely any consultation with the public.
The reforms were introduced with little consultation because they were only partly successful.
The reforms were partly successful because they involved extensive public consultation.
It is surprising that the reforms were only partly successful, given the consultation.
answer: It is not surprising that the reforms have had limited success, as there was scarcely any consultation with the public.
why: 'hardly surprising' = 'not surprising'; 'given that' = 'as'.
tr: Reformların yalnızca kısmen başarılı olması, halkla çok az istişare edilerek uygulanmaları göz önüne alındığında pek şaşırtıcı değil.
ruleText: hardly surprising = şaşırtıcı değil. given that = ...göz önüne alınca.

target: In the absence of clear evidence, the court could not reach a verdict.
options: With clear evidence, the court was unable to decide the case.
The court reached a verdict because the evidence was clear.
Clear evidence was absent because the court could not decide.
Without clear evidence, the court was unable to decide the case.
answer: Without clear evidence, the court was unable to decide the case.
why: 'In the absence of' = 'Without'; 'reach a verdict' = 'decide the case'.
tr: Net kanıt bulunmadığı için mahkeme bir karara varamadı.
ruleText: in the absence of = without. reach a verdict = decide.

target: In view of the bad weather, the event has been cancelled.
options: The event has been moved to a place with better weather.
Because of the bad weather, the event will not take place.
The event has been cancelled although the weather is good.
The bad weather improved after the event was cancelled.
answer: Because of the bad weather, the event will not take place.
why: 'In view of' = 'Because of'; 'cancelled' = 'will not take place'.
tr: Kötü hava koşulları nedeniyle etkinlik iptal edildi.
ruleText: in view of = because of (göz önüne alınca).

target: With regard to your complaint, we will investigate the matter.
options: As for your complaint, we are going to look into the matter.
Because of your complaint, you will be investigated.
Regarding your complaint, we have already closed the matter.
Your complaint will be ignored until the matter is investigated.
answer: As for your complaint, we are going to look into the matter.
why: 'With regard to' = 'As for'; 'investigate' = 'look into'.
tr: Şikâyetinize gelince, konuyu inceleyeceğiz.
ruleText: with regard to = as for (...e gelince). investigate = look into.

target: He is anything but lazy.
options: He is not in the least lazy.
He is lazy, but only a little.
He is lazy because he does anything.
He is nothing but lazy.
answer: He is not in the least lazy.
why: 'anything but' = 'far from' (hiç değil).
tr: O hiç de tembel değil.
ruleText: anything but = hiç de ... değil. nothing but = yalnızca.

target: The company has all but collapsed.
options: The company has collapsed completely, with all of its branches.
The company has come very close to collapsing.
The company has not collapsed at all.
The company will collapse unless all its branches are sold.
answer: The company has come very close to collapsing.
why: 'all but' = 'almost'.
tr: Şirket neredeyse çöktü.
ruleText: all but = almost (neredeyse). 'all but' ≠ 'all except' her zaman.

target: I can't help feeling that something is wrong.
options: I cannot stop myself from feeling that something is wrong.
I feel that something is wrong only when I help.
I refuse to feel that something is wrong.
I can't help anyone because something is wrong.
answer: I cannot stop myself from feeling that something is wrong.
why: 'can't help V-ing' = 'cannot stop myself from V-ing'.
tr: Bir şeylerin ters gittiğini hissetmekten kendimi alamıyorum.
ruleText: can't help + V-ing = kendini alamamak.

target: Unemployment fell from 10 percent to 6 percent last year.
options: Unemployment fell by six percentage points last year.
Unemployment stayed between 6 and 10 percent last year.
Unemployment rose from 6 percent to 10 percent last year.
Last year the unemployment rate dropped by four percentage points.
answer: Last year the unemployment rate dropped by four percentage points.
why: 10'dan 6'ya düşüş = 4 puanlık düşüş.
tr: İşsizlik geçen yıl yüzde 10'dan yüzde 6'ya düştü.
ruleText: fall from A to B = decrease by (A − B). Fark hesaplanmalı.

target: Prices have doubled over the past decade.
options: Prices are now twice what they were ten years ago.
Prices have halved over the past decade.
Prices have doubled only in the last two years.
Prices are now ten times higher than ten years ago.
answer: Prices are now twice what they were ten years ago.
why: 'doubled over the past decade' = 'twice what they were ten years ago'.
tr: Fiyatlar son on yılda iki katına çıktı.
ruleText: double = iki katına çıkmak. decade = on yıl.

target: There are two approaches: the former prioritises speed, whereas the latter places greater emphasis on accuracy, even at the expense of efficiency.
options: Of the two approaches, the first puts accuracy first, while the second values speed more, even if efficiency suffers.
Both approaches put speed first, although the second sacrifices accuracy.
The first approach sacrifices speed to improve efficiency, while the second ignores accuracy.
Of the two approaches, the first puts speed first, while the second values accuracy more, even if efficiency suffers.
answer: Of the two approaches, the first puts speed first, while the second values accuracy more, even if efficiency suffers.
why: 'former' = ilk, 'latter' = ikinci; 'at the expense of' = 'even if ... suffers'.
wrong: İkisi de hızı öne alıyor denmiş.
tr: İki yaklaşım var: birincisi hıza öncelik verir, ikincisi ise verimlilik pahasına bile olsa doğruluğa daha çok önem verir.
ruleText: the former = ilki, the latter = sonuncusu. at the expense of = ...pahasına.

target: It was not until the late nineteenth century that women were admitted to the university in significant numbers, and even then they faced considerable hostility.
options: Women faced hostility only after they were admitted in significant numbers in the late 1800s.
Considerable hostility prevented women from ever being admitted to the university.
Women were admitted to the university in large numbers before the late 1800s, without any hostility.
Women only began to enter the university in large numbers in the late 1800s, and they still met strong opposition.
answer: Women only began to enter the university in large numbers in the late 1800s, and they still met strong opposition.
why: 'It was not until ... that' = 'only began ... in the late 1800s'.
tr: Kadınlar üniversiteye önemli sayılarda ancak on dokuzuncu yüzyıl sonlarında kabul edildi ve o zaman bile ciddi düşmanlıkla karşılaştı.
ruleText: It was not until X that = ancak X'ten sonra. even then = o zaman bile.

target: Prior to the surgery, the patient was given a sedative.
options: The patient was given a sedative during the operation.
Before the operation, the patient received a calming drug.
After the operation, the patient received a calming drug.
The patient refused the sedative before the surgery.
answer: Before the operation, the patient received a calming drug.
why: 'Prior to' = 'Before'; 'sedative' = 'calming drug'.
tr: Ameliyattan önce hastaya sakinleştirici verildi.
ruleText: prior to = before. sedative = sakinleştirici ilaç.

target: The side effects of the drug are mild.
options: The drug causes only slight unwanted reactions.
The drug is mild because it has side effects.
The drug has no side effects.
The drug causes severe unwanted reactions.
answer: The drug causes only slight unwanted reactions.
why: 'mild' = 'slight'; 'side effects' = 'unwanted reactions'.
tr: İlacın yan etkileri hafiftir.
ruleText: mild = slight (hafif). side effects = istenmeyen etkiler.

target: A third of the patients reported improvement.
options: Two thirds of the patients said they felt better.
About 33 percent of the patients said they felt better.
A third of the patients said they felt worse.
Only a few patients said they felt better.
answer: About 33 percent of the patients said they felt better.
why: 'A third' = 'about 33 percent'; 'reported improvement' = 'felt better'.
tr: Hastaların üçte biri iyileşme bildirdi.
ruleText: a third = yaklaşık yüzde 33. improvement = better.

target: The disease is more common in men than in women.
options: The disease is equally common in men and women.
Women are less likely than men to suffer from the disease.
The disease occurs in men only.
Women are more likely than men to suffer from the disease.
answer: Women are less likely than men to suffer from the disease.
why: 'more common in men' = 'women less likely'.
tr: Hastalık erkeklerde kadınlardan daha yaygındır.
ruleText: more common in A than B = B daha az olasılıkla.

target: Patients with this condition tend to recover within a month.
options: Patients with this condition recover only after a month.
Patients with this condition never recover within a month.
Patients with this condition tend to recover without treatment.
Most patients with this condition usually get better within four weeks.
answer: Most patients with this condition usually get better within four weeks.
why: 'tend to' = 'usually'; 'within a month' = 'within four weeks'.
tr: Bu rahatsızlığı olan hastalar genellikle bir ay içinde iyileşir.
ruleText: tend to = genellikle ... eğilimindedir.

target: The nurse was reprimanded for giving the wrong dose.
options: The nurse reprimanded the doctor for the wrong dose.
The dose was wrong because the nurse had been reprimanded.
The nurse was praised for giving the right dose.
The nurse was told off because she administered an incorrect dose.
answer: The nurse was told off because she administered an incorrect dose.
why: 'reprimanded' = 'told off'; 'wrong dose' = 'incorrect dose'.
tr: Hemşire yanlış doz verdiği için azarlandı.
ruleText: reprimand = tell off (azarlamak). for + V-ing = nedeniyle.

target: Few of the participants had any previous experience of meditation.
options: None of the participants experienced meditation during the study.
Many participants had practised meditation before.
Almost all the participants were new to meditation.
A few participants had never heard of meditation.
answer: Almost all the participants were new to meditation.
why: 'Few ... had any experience' = 'almost all were new'.
tr: Katılımcıların çok azının meditasyonla ilgili önceden deneyimi vardı.
ruleText: few + had any = neredeyse hiçbiri. 'A few' ≠ 'few'.

target: Insufficient sleep may lead to a weakened immune system.
options: Too much sleep can weaken the immune system.
A strong immune system may lead to insufficient sleep.
Not getting enough rest can result in lower resistance to illness.
Sleep has no effect on resistance to illness.
answer: Not getting enough rest can result in lower resistance to illness.
why: 'Insufficient sleep' = 'Not getting enough rest'; 'lead to' = 'result in'.
tr: Yetersiz uyku zayıflamış bir bağışıklık sistemine yol açabilir.
ruleText: lead to = result in. insufficient = not enough.

target: That smoking causes lung cancer is now beyond dispute, yet it took several decades of research before the link was universally acknowledged.
options: It is still disputed whether smoking causes lung cancer, although research has continued for decades.
Nobody now doubts that smoking causes lung cancer, but it was a long time before everyone accepted the connection.
The link between smoking and lung cancer was accepted immediately, yet it is disputed today.
Research on smoking took decades because the link was already acknowledged.
answer: Nobody now doubts that smoking causes lung cancer, but it was a long time before everyone accepted the connection.
why: 'beyond dispute' = 'nobody doubts'; 'took several decades ... before' = 'a long time before'.
tr: Sigaranın akciğer kanserine yol açtığı artık tartışma götürmez; yine de bağlantının evrensel olarak kabul edilmesi onlarca yıllık araştırma aldı.
ruleText: beyond dispute = tartışılmaz. it took ... before = ...den sonra ancak.

target: Should the symptoms persist, patients are advised to seek medical attention, whatever the time of day.
options: If the symptoms do not go away, patients ought to get medical help at any hour.
Patients should seek medical help only during the day, even when the symptoms persist.
If the symptoms go away, patients should seek medical help the next day.
The symptoms persist because patients do not seek medical help at night.
answer: If the symptoms do not go away, patients ought to get medical help at any hour.
why: 'Should ... persist' = 'If ... do not go away'; 'whatever the time of day' = 'at any hour'.
tr: Belirtiler devam ederse hastaların günün hangi saati olursa olsun tıbbi yardım alması önerilir.
ruleText: Should + özne + V = If + özne + V (devrik koşul). whatever the time = herhangi bir saatte.

target: The temperature fell sharply after sunset.
options: The sun set because the temperature fell sharply.
The temperature fell slowly before sunset.
Temperatures dropped rapidly once the sun had set.
The temperature rose sharply after sunset.
answer: Temperatures dropped rapidly once the sun had set.
why: 'fell sharply' = 'rapid drop'; 'after sunset' = 'once the sun had gone down'.
tr: Gün batımından sonra sıcaklık keskin biçimde düştü.
ruleText: fall sharply = rapid drop. after sunset = once the sun had gone down.

target: Ice is less dense than water.
options: Ice and water have the same density.
Water is denser than ice.
Water floats on ice.
Ice is denser than water.
answer: Water is denser than ice.
why: 'less dense' ters çevrilince 'denser': su, buzdan yoğundur.
tr: Buz sudan daha az yoğundur.
ruleText: A is less dense than B = B is denser than A.

target: A great deal of energy is lost as heat.
options: Little energy is lost as heat.
Energy is gained as heat.
Much energy is wasted as heat.
A great deal of heat is turned into energy.
answer: Much energy is wasted as heat.
why: 'a great deal of' = 'much'; 'lost' = 'wasted'.
tr: Büyük miktarda enerji ısı olarak kaybolur.
ruleText: a great deal of = much (çok miktarda).

target: The cause of the explosion is yet to be determined.
options: The explosion was determined to have no cause.
The cause of the explosion has just been determined.
Investigators still do not know what caused the explosion.
The cause of the explosion was determined before it happened.
answer: Investigators still do not know what caused the explosion.
why: 'is yet to be determined' = 'still do not know'.
tr: Patlamanın nedeni henüz belirlenmedi.
ruleText: is yet to be + V3 = henüz ...medi.

target: The reaction proceeded more slowly than anticipated.
options: The reaction was not as fast as had been expected.
The reaction was faster than had been expected.
Nothing had been expected from the reaction.
The reaction proceeded as quickly as anticipated.
answer: The reaction was not as fast as had been expected.
why: 'more slowly than anticipated' = 'not as fast as expected'.
tr: Tepkime beklenenden daha yavaş ilerledi.
ruleText: more slowly than = not as fast as.

target: Not all insects are harmful to crops.
options: All insects are harmful to crops.
Only insects are harmful to crops.
Some insects do no harm to crops.
No insects are harmful to crops.
answer: Some insects do no harm to crops.
why: 'Not all' = 'some ... not'.
tr: Her böcek ürünler için zararlı değildir.
ruleText: not all = bazıları değil. 'not all' ≠ 'none'.

target: Greenhouse gases trap heat, which in turn raises global temperatures.
options: Greenhouse gases lower global temperatures by trapping heat.
Heat traps greenhouse gases, so global temperatures fall.
Because greenhouse gases hold in heat, global temperatures go up.
Global temperatures rise, which in turn causes greenhouse gases to trap heat.
answer: Because greenhouse gases hold in heat, global temperatures go up.
why: 'which in turn raises' = 'so ... go up'. Neden: gazlar ısıyı tutar.
wrong: Özneler yer değiştirmiş ve düşüş denmiş.
tr: Sera gazları ısıyı hapseder, bu da küresel sıcaklıkları yükseltir.
ruleText: which in turn = bunun da sonucunda. Zincirleme neden-sonuç.

target: There is a growing consensus among scientists that the climate is changing.
options: The climate is changing because scientists agree.
Fewer and fewer scientists agree that the climate is changing.
More and more scientists agree that the climate is changing.
Scientists disagree about whether the climate is changing.
answer: More and more scientists agree that the climate is changing.
why: 'growing consensus' = 'more and more agree'.
tr: Bilim insanları arasında iklimin değiştiği konusunda artan bir fikir birliği var.
ruleText: growing consensus = giderek artan uzlaşı.

target: Despite the considerable progress made in recent decades, our understanding of the processes governing the deep ocean remains fragmentary.
options: Even though much has been achieved lately, we still know only parts of how the deep ocean works.
Thanks to recent progress, we now understand every process in the deep ocean.
Progress in recent decades has been limited because our understanding is fragmentary.
Our understanding of the deep ocean is complete, despite the lack of progress.
answer: Even though much has been achieved lately, we still know only parts of how the deep ocean works.
why: 'Despite the considerable progress' = 'Even though much has been achieved'; 'fragmentary' = 'only parts'.
tr: Son on yıllarda kaydedilen önemli ilerlemeye rağmen derin okyanusu yöneten süreçler hakkındaki anlayışımız parçalı kalmaya devam ediyor.
ruleText: Despite + isim = Even though + cümle. fragmentary = parça parça, eksik.

target: Rarely, if ever, does a single gene determine a complex trait; more often, many genes interact with the environment to shape it.
options: A complex trait is usually decided by a single gene, regardless of the environment.
A single gene almost never decides a complex trait; several genes and the environment usually do.
Genes seldom interact, though a single gene often determines a complex trait.
Environmental factors alone shape a complex trait, since genes rarely interact.
answer: A single gene almost never decides a complex trait; several genes and the environment usually do.
why: 'Rarely, if ever' = 'almost never'; 'many genes interact with the environment' = 'several genes work together with environmental factors'.
tr: Karmaşık bir özelliği tek bir gen nadiren, hatta hiç belirlemez; daha sık olarak birçok gen çevreyle etkileşerek onu şekillendirir.
ruleText: Rarely, if ever = neredeyse hiç. Devrik yapı: Rarely does ... determine.

target: The government plans to build more affordable housing.
options: The authorities intend to construct additional low-cost homes.
The government plans to sell its affordable housing.
The government has already built enough affordable housing.
The authorities intend to build fewer low-cost homes.
answer: The authorities intend to construct additional low-cost homes.
why: 'plans to build' = 'intend to construct'; 'affordable housing' = 'low-cost homes'.
tr: Hükümet daha fazla uygun fiyatlı konut inşa etmeyi planlıyor.
ruleText: plan to = intend to. affordable = low-cost.

target: Unemployment is highest among young people.
options: Unemployment is highest among old people.
Unemployment is lowest among young people.
Young people are never unemployed.
Young people are the most likely to be jobless.
answer: Young people are the most likely to be jobless.
why: 'highest among' = 'more likely than any other group'.
tr: İşsizlik en çok gençler arasında yüksektir.
ruleText: highest among = en yüksek; more ... than any other.

target: The law came into effect in January.
options: The law will come into effect next January.
The law was abolished in January.
The law was passed in January but never applied.
The law became valid in January.
answer: The law became valid in January.
why: 'came into effect' = 'became valid'.
tr: Yasa Ocak ayında yürürlüğe girdi.
ruleText: come into effect = take effect = yürürlüğe girmek.

target: Only a small proportion of the population voted in the election.
options: Turnout in the election was very high.
A large proportion of the population voted in the election.
Turnout in the election was very low.
The election was won by a small proportion of voters.
answer: Turnout in the election was very low.
why: 'Only a small proportion voted' = 'turnout was low'.
tr: Seçimde nüfusun yalnızca küçük bir bölümü oy kullandı.
ruleText: only a small proportion = düşük oran (low turnout).

target: The strike, which began on Monday, has paralysed the transport system.
options: The transport system is running normally despite the strike that started on Monday.
The strike has not affected the transport system since Monday.
The transport system began a strike on Monday that has ended.
The transport system has come to a halt because of the strike that started on Monday.
answer: The transport system has come to a halt because of the strike that started on Monday.
why: 'paralysed' = 'come to a halt'.
tr: Pazartesi günü başlayan grev ulaşım sistemini felç etti.
ruleText: paralyse = come to a halt (durdurmak).

target: He is held responsible for the failure of the project.
options: He is praised for the project's success.
He is blamed for the project's failure.
He holds the failure of the project responsible.
The failure of the project is responsible for him.
answer: He is blamed for the project's failure.
why: 'held responsible' = 'blamed'.
tr: Projenin başarısızlığından o sorumlu tutuluyor.
ruleText: be held responsible for = be blamed for.

target: Immigration has contributed to the growth of the economy.
options: Immigration has slowed the growth of the economy.
The economy has grown partly because of immigration.
Immigration has grown because of the economy.
The economy has grown without any help from immigration.
answer: The economy has grown partly because of immigration.
why: 'contributed to' = 'partly because of'.
tr: Göç ekonominin büyümesine katkıda bulunmuştur.
ruleText: contribute to = partly cause (katkıda bulunmak).

target: The two parties have little in common.
options: The two parties have a lot in common.
The two parties have nothing to say to the common people.
The two parties are very different from each other.
The two parties share the same views on most issues.
answer: The two parties are very different from each other.
why: 'have little in common' = 'very different'.
tr: İki partinin ortak yönü çok az.
ruleText: have little in common = çok farklı. 'a little' ≠ 'little'.

target: It stands to reason that a society which neglects the education of its youngest members will, in due course, pay the price in lost productivity.
options: Clearly, a society that ignores the schooling of its children will eventually suffer lower output.
It is unreasonable to expect a society that neglects children's education to suffer anything.
A society pays for education only after productivity is lost.
A society that educates its children well will immediately lose productivity.
answer: Clearly, a society that ignores the schooling of its children will eventually suffer lower output.
why: 'stands to reason' = 'Clearly'; 'in due course' = 'eventually'; 'pay the price in lost productivity' = 'suffer lower output'.
tr: En küçük üyelerinin eğitimini ihmal eden bir toplumun zamanla verimlilik kaybıyla bedel ödeyeceği açıktır.
ruleText: It stands to reason that = ...olması mantıklıdır. in due course = zamanla.

target: So far from alleviating the shortage of skilled workers, the new immigration rules have, if anything, aggravated it.
options: The new immigration rules have had no effect on the shortage of skilled workers.
The shortage of skilled workers aggravated the new immigration rules.
The new immigration rules have eased the shortage of skilled workers, if anything.
The new rules have not eased the skilled-worker shortage; if anything they worsened it.
answer: The new rules have not eased the skilled-worker shortage; if anything they worsened it.
why: 'So far from alleviating' = 'have not eased'; 'aggravated' = 'made worse'.
tr: Yeni göç kuralları vasıflı işçi sıkıntısını hafifletmek şöyle dursun, daha da kötüleştirdi.
ruleText: So far from V-ing = ...mek şöyle dursun. if anything = hatta, belki.

target: On arriving at the station, she bought a ticket.
options: She bought a ticket before she reached the station.
She arrived at the station after buying a ticket.
She reached the station but did not buy a ticket.
As soon as she reached the station, she bought a ticket.
answer: As soon as she reached the station, she bought a ticket.
why: 'On arriving' = 'As soon as she reached'. Önce varış, sonra bilet.
tr: İstasyona varır varmaz bir bilet aldı.
ruleText: On + V-ing = as soon as (...ir ...mez).

target: The government has set up a committee to look into the matter.
options: The government has closed a committee that looked into the matter.
A committee has set up the government to examine the issue.
The authorities have established a panel to examine the issue.
The authorities have appointed a panel to ignore the issue.
answer: The authorities have established a panel to examine the issue.
why: 'set up' = 'established'; 'look into' = 'examine'.
tr: Hükümet konuyu incelemek için bir komite kurdu.
ruleText: set up = establish. look into = examine.

target: Having finished the report, he went home.
options: He went home, so he could not finish the report.
He went home because he did not finish the report.
After he had completed the report, he left for home.
He finished the report after he went home.
answer: After he had completed the report, he left for home.
why: 'Having finished' = 'After he had completed'. Önce rapor, sonra eve gitme.
tr: Raporu bitirdikten sonra eve gitti.
ruleText: Having + V3 = After + had V3 (önce biten eylem).

target: He stopped to talk to her.
options: He had to stop because she talked to him.
He stopped her from talking.
He paused in order to speak to her.
He no longer spoke to her.
answer: He paused in order to speak to her.
why: 'stop to V' = yaptığı işi bırakıp V etmek.
tr: Onunla konuşmak için durdu.
ruleText: stop to V = V etmek için durmak. stop V-ing = V etmeyi bırakmak.

target: She remembered locking the door.
options: She remembered that she still had to lock the door.
She locked the door so that she would not forget.
She forgot to lock the door.
She recalled that she had locked the door.
answer: She recalled that she had locked the door.
why: 'remember V-ing' = geçmişte yaptığını hatırlamak.
tr: Kapıyı kilitlediğini hatırladı.
ruleText: remember V-ing = yaptığını hatırlamak. remember to V = yapmayı hatırlamak.

target: Try as he might, he could not open the jar.
options: He might have opened the jar if he had tried.
However hard he tried, the jar would not open for him.
He did not try, so he could not open the jar.
He opened the jar because he tried hard.
answer: However hard he tried, the jar would not open for him.
why: 'Try as he might' = 'However hard he tried'.
tr: Ne kadar denese de kavanozu açamadı.
ruleText: Try as + özne + might = ne kadar denese de (However hard).

target: He was made redundant when the factory closed.
options: He lost his job because the factory shut down.
The factory closed because he was made redundant.
He was promoted when the factory closed.
He closed the factory when he was made redundant.
answer: He lost his job because the factory shut down.
why: 'made redundant' = 'lost his job'.
tr: Fabrika kapanınca işten çıkarıldı.
ruleText: be made redundant = işten çıkarılmak (gereksiz kalmak).

target: Much as I admire her courage, I cannot support a proposal that would put so many lives at risk.
options: Although I greatly respect her bravery, I am unable to back a plan endangering so many people.
I cannot admire her courage, so I do not support the proposal.
Because I admire her courage so much, I support the plan that puts many lives at risk.
I support the proposal because it puts many lives at risk, much as I admire her.
answer: Although I greatly respect her bravery, I am unable to back a plan endangering so many people.
why: 'Much as' = 'Although ... greatly'; 'put lives at risk' = 'endanger people'.
tr: Onun cesaretine ne kadar hayran olsam da bu kadar çok hayatı riske atacak bir öneriyi destekleyemem.
ruleText: Much as + özne + fiil = Although (ne kadar ... olsam da).

target: So absorbed was she in the novel that she failed to notice the passing of the hours.
options: She stopped reading the novel because she noticed the hours passing.
She noticed the passing of the hours only because the novel was absorbing.
She was so engrossed in the book that she lost track of time.
The novel was so dull that she watched the hours pass.
answer: She was so engrossed in the book that she lost track of time.
why: 'So absorbed was she' = 'so engrossed'; 'failed to notice the passing of the hours' = 'lost track of time'.
tr: Romana o kadar dalmıştı ki saatlerin geçtiğini fark edemedi.
ruleText: So + sıfat + was + özne + that = o kadar ... ki (devrik). fail to notice = lose track.

target: What the figures fail to reveal is the extent to which regional disparities have been masked by national averages.
options: Regional disparities have hidden the national averages from the figures.
The extent of regional disparities is clearly revealed by the national averages.
The figures reveal that national averages have exposed regional disparities.
The statistics do not show how much national averages hide differences between regions.
answer: The statistics do not show how much national averages hide differences between regions.
why: 'fail to reveal' = 'do not show'; 'masked' = 'hide'.
tr: Rakamların ortaya koymadığı şey, bölgesel eşitsizliklerin ulusal ortalamalarla ne ölçüde gizlendiğidir.
ruleText: What ... is ... = vurgulu cümle. mask = hide.

target: Smoking has been linked to a number of serious diseases.
options: Smoking has been proven to prevent serious diseases.
Several grave illnesses are associated with smoking.
Smoking is unrelated to serious diseases.
Serious diseases have caused many people to smoke.
answer: Several grave illnesses are associated with smoking.
why: 'linked to' = 'associated with'; 'a number of serious diseases' = 'several grave illnesses'.
tr: Sigara içmek çeşitli ciddi hastalıklarla ilişkilendirilmiştir.
ruleText: linked to = associated with.

target: The doctor carried out a thorough examination.
options: The doctor postponed the examination.
The doctor conducted a complete check-up.
The doctor avoided a thorough examination.
The doctor was examined thoroughly.
answer: The doctor conducted a complete check-up.
why: 'carried out' = 'conducted'; 'thorough examination' = 'complete check-up'.
tr: Doktor ayrıntılı bir muayene yaptı.
ruleText: carry out = conduct (gerçekleştirmek).

target: The drug is liable to cause drowsiness.
options: The drug is used to treat drowsiness.
The drug is legally required to cause drowsiness.
The drug is likely to make people sleepy.
The drug is unable to cause drowsiness.
answer: The drug is likely to make people sleepy.
why: 'be liable to' = 'be likely to'.
tr: Bu ilacın uyku hali yapma olasılığı yüksek.
ruleText: be liable to V = V etme olasılığı yüksek. 'liable' hukuki anlamıyla karıştırılmamalı.

target: In the event of an emergency, call this number.
options: Emergencies occur whenever you call this number.
Do not call this number in an emergency.
If an emergency occurs, dial this number.
Call this number after the emergency has ended.
answer: If an emergency occurs, dial this number.
why: 'In the event of' = 'If ... occurs'.
tr: Acil durumda bu numarayı arayın.
ruleText: in the event of + isim = If + cümle.

target: He is prone to headaches when he is stressed.
options: Stress often gives him bad headaches and pain.
He has headaches only after he stops being stressed.
He is stressed because he suffers from headaches.
He is protected from headaches when stressed.
answer: Stress often gives him bad headaches and pain.
why: 'prone to' = 'often gets'.
tr: Stresliyken baş ağrısına yatkın.
ruleText: be prone to = ...e yatkın olmak.

target: The cancer was caught early enough to be treated before it could spread.
options: The cancer was found in time to prevent its spreading.
The cancer spread because it was found early enough.
The cancer was found too late to prevent its spreading.
The cancer was prevented from spreading before it was found.
answer: The cancer was found in time to prevent its spreading.
why: 'early enough to be treated before it could spread' = 'in time to prevent its spreading'.
tr: Kanser, yayılmadan tedavi edilebilecek kadar erken yakalandı.
ruleText: early enough to V = zamanında V edilebilir şekilde. in time = zamanında.

target: He pretended not to notice that his colleague was ill.
options: He noticed that his colleague was ill and helped him.
His colleague pretended not to be ill.
He really did not notice that his colleague was ill.
He acted as if he had not seen that his colleague was unwell.
answer: He acted as if he had not seen that his colleague was unwell.
why: 'pretended not to notice' = 'acted as if he had not seen'.
tr: İş arkadaşının hasta olduğunu fark etmemiş gibi yaptı.
ruleText: pretend not to V = V etmemiş gibi yapmak.

target: It is by no means certain that the benefits of the screening programme outweigh the distress caused by false positives.
options: The programme's benefits are doubtful because false positives never cause distress.
It is certain that the screening programme's advantages exceed the anxiety created by incorrect results.
False positives cause distress only when the programme has benefits.
Nobody can say for sure that the programme's advantages exceed the anxiety created by incorrect results.
answer: Nobody can say for sure that the programme's advantages exceed the anxiety created by incorrect results.
why: 'by no means certain' = 'nobody can say for sure'; 'outweigh' = 'exceed'; 'false positives' = 'incorrect results'.
tr: Tarama programının yararlarının yanlış pozitif sonuçların yarattığı sıkıntıdan ağır bastığı hiç de kesin değildir.
ruleText: by no means certain = hiç de kesin değil. outweigh = ağır basmak.

target: Not having been tested on children, the vaccine cannot, strictly speaking, be recommended for them.
options: The vaccine is tested on children because it cannot be recommended.
Because it was tested on children, the vaccine is recommended for them.
Having been tested on children, the vaccine cannot be recommended for adults.
Since it has never been trialled on children, the vaccine cannot properly be advised for them.
answer: Since it has never been trialled on children, the vaccine cannot properly be advised for them.
why: 'Not having been tested' = 'Since it has never been trialled'; 'strictly speaking' = 'properly'.
tr: Çocuklar üzerinde test edilmediği için aşı, kesin konuşmak gerekirse, onlara önerilemez.
ruleText: Not having + V3 = Since ... has never been V3. strictly speaking = tam anlamıyla.

target: In the unlikely event that the treatment should fail, alternative therapies remain available.
options: The treatment is likely to fail unless alternative therapies are provided.
Alternative therapies are available only if the treatment is successful.
Even if the treatment were to fail, which is improbable, other options are still open.
Since the treatment will probably fail, alternative therapies are unavailable.
answer: Even if the treatment were to fail, which is improbable, other options are still open.
why: 'In the unlikely event that ... should fail' = 'Even if ... were to fail, which is improbable'.
tr: Tedavinin başarısız olması düşük bir ihtimal olsa da bu durumda alternatif tedaviler mevcut.
ruleText: In the unlikely event that + should = çok düşük ihtimalle ... olursa.

target: Glaciers are melting at an alarming rate.
options: Glaciers are melting very slowly.
Glaciers have stopped melting at last.
Glaciers are shrinking dangerously fast.
Glaciers are being alarmed by melting.
answer: Glaciers are shrinking dangerously fast.
why: 'at an alarming rate' = 'dangerously fast'; 'melting' = 'shrinking'.
tr: Buzullar endişe verici bir hızla eriyor.
ruleText: at an alarming rate = endişe verici hızla.

target: Heat always flows from a hotter object to a colder one.
options: Colder objects always give heat to hotter ones.
Warmth always moves from the cooler body to the warmer one.
Hot objects never lose any heat.
Warmth always moves from the warmer body to the cooler one.
answer: Warmth always moves from the warmer body to the cooler one.
why: 'hotter' = 'warmer'; 'colder' = 'cooler'; yön korunmalı.
tr: Isı her zaman sıcak cisimden soğuk cisme akar.
ruleText: from A to B yönü korunmalı.

target: Plants absorb carbon dioxide, thereby reducing its concentration in the atmosphere.
options: Plants reduce the atmosphere in order to absorb carbon dioxide.
By taking in carbon dioxide, plants lower its level in the air.
The atmosphere absorbs plants, thereby reducing carbon dioxide.
Plants release carbon dioxide and so raise its level in the air.
answer: By taking in carbon dioxide, plants lower its level in the air.
why: 'thereby reducing' = 'By taking in ... lower'.
tr: Bitkiler karbondioksiti emerek atmosferdeki oranını azaltır.
ruleText: thereby + V-ing = böylece (sonuç).

target: The substance remains solid until it reaches its melting point.
options: The substance stays solid until it hits its melting temperature.
The substance melts before it reaches its melting point.
The substance is solid only after it has melted.
The substance becomes solid once it reaches its melting point.
answer: The substance stays solid until it hits its melting temperature.
why: 'until' = 'up to the moment'.
tr: Madde erime noktasına ulaşana kadar katı kalır.
ruleText: until = o ana kadar (süreç sınırı).

target: The compass needle aligns with the Earth's magnetic field; otherwise it would point randomly.
options: The needle aligns with the field only when it points randomly.
The needle points randomly because it aligns with the magnetic field.
The planet's magnetic field would disappear if the needle aligned.
The needle lines up with the magnetic field; if not, it would point anywhere.
answer: The needle lines up with the magnetic field; if not, it would point anywhere.
why: 'otherwise' = 'if it did not'.
tr: Pusula iğnesi Dünya'nın manyetik alanına hizalanır; aksi halde rastgele yönü gösterirdi.
ruleText: otherwise = aksi takdirde (if not).

target: Advanced telescopes enable astronomers to observe distant galaxies in unprecedented detail.
options: Astronomers enable telescopes to see galaxies in detail.
Modern telescopes let astronomers see far galaxies in unmatched detail.
Modern telescopes prevent astronomers from seeing galaxies clearly.
Distant galaxies make telescopes more advanced than ever.
answer: Modern telescopes let astronomers see far galaxies in unmatched detail.
why: 'enable ... to' = 'allow ... to'; 'unprecedented' = 'more than ever before'.
tr: Gelişmiş teleskoplar gökbilimcilerin uzak gökadaları eşi görülmemiş ayrıntıda gözlemlemesini sağlar.
ruleText: enable sb to V = ...in V etmesini sağlamak.

target: When zinc reacts with acid, it produces hydrogen gas.
options: Acid prevents zinc from producing hydrogen.
Hydrogen combined with acid gives off zinc.
Zinc is produced when hydrogen reacts with acid.
Zinc combined with acid gives off hydrogen.
answer: Zinc combined with acid gives off hydrogen.
why: 'reacts with acid, produces hydrogen' = 'combined with acid gives off hydrogen'.
tr: Çinko asitle tepkimeye girdiğinde hidrojen gazı üretir.
ruleText: react with = tepkimeye girmek. produce = give off.

target: A model is useful only insofar as it has been validated against observational data.
options: A model is valuable only to the degree it is checked against observations.
A model is useful even when it contradicts observations.
Observational data are useful insofar as they match any model.
A model is validated only if it is useful.
answer: A model is valuable only to the degree it is checked against observations.
why: 'insofar as' = 'to the degree that'; 'validated against observational data' = 'checked against real observations'.
tr: Bir model ancak gözlem verilerine karşı doğrulandığı ölçüde yararlıdır.
ruleText: insofar as = ... ölçüde / ... derecede.

target: Only in the past few decades has it become possible to sequence an entire genome within a matter of days.
options: It was possible to sequence a genome in days long before the past few decades.
Sequencing a whole genome in just a few days has been feasible only since fairly recently.
Sequencing a genome has taken decades in the recent past.
Within days, scientists have stopped sequencing entire genomes.
answer: Sequencing a whole genome in just a few days has been feasible only since fairly recently.
why: 'Only in the past few decades has it become possible' = 'feasible only since fairly recently'.
tr: Tüm bir genomu birkaç gün içinde dizilemek ancak son birkaç on yılda mümkün oldu.
ruleText: Only in/after + zaman + yardımcı fiil + özne (devrik) = ancak ... da.

target: Few phenomena have attracted as much research as lightning, yet its initiation remains poorly understood.
options: Lightning has been studied more than almost any other natural event, but how it starts is still unclear.
How lightning starts is well understood, which is why it is widely studied.
Few natural events are as well researched as lightning, so its start is fully explained.
Lightning has been studied little, so how it starts is still unclear.
answer: Lightning has been studied more than almost any other natural event, but how it starts is still unclear.
why: 'Few phenomena ... as much research' = 'studied more than almost any other'; 'initiation remains poorly understood' = 'how it starts is still unclear'.
tr: Çok az olay yıldırım kadar araştırma çekmiştir; yine de nasıl başladığı hâlâ iyi anlaşılamamıştır.
ruleText: Few ... as much as = neredeyse hiçbiri ... kadar değil (en çok çalışılanlardan).

target: The minister put forward a new plan for housing.
options: The minister put the housing plan off for years.
The minister suggested a new housing proposal.
The minister rejected the new housing plan.
A new plan forced the minister to resign.
answer: The minister suggested a new housing proposal.
why: 'put forward' = 'suggested'.
tr: Bakan konut için yeni bir plan öne sürdü.
ruleText: put forward = propose / suggest.

target: The reforms brought about a significant change in society.
options: The reforms resulted in a major social transformation.
The reforms prevented any change in society.
A change in society made the reforms unnecessary.
Society brought about the reforms.
answer: The reforms resulted in a major social transformation.
why: 'brought about' = 'resulted in'.
tr: Reformlar toplumda önemli bir değişime yol açtı.
ruleText: bring about = cause / result in.

target: I would rather you did not smoke in here.
options: I wish you had not smoked in here.
I do not mind if you smoke inside.
I would prefer it if you did not smoke inside.
I would rather smoke in here than you.
answer: I would prefer it if you did not smoke inside.
why: 'would rather + past' = 'would prefer it if'.
tr: Burada sigara içmemeni tercih ederim.
ruleText: would rather + özne + V2 = ... -masını tercih ederim.

target: The law protects workers as well as employers.
options: The law protects employers but not workers.
The law protects workers instead of employers.
Employers protect workers as the law requires.
The law safeguards both workers and employers.
answer: The law safeguards both workers and employers.
why: 'as well as' = 'both ... and'.
tr: Yasa işverenleri olduğu kadar işçileri de korur.
ruleText: A as well as B = hem B hem A (both).

target: Poverty affects women disproportionately.
options: Women suffer from poverty more than their numbers would suggest.
Poverty rarely has any effect on women at all.
Poverty affects women and men in exactly equal measure.
Women are the main cause of poverty in society.
answer: Women suffer from poverty more than their numbers would suggest.
why: 'disproportionately' = 'harder than their share would suggest'.
tr: Yoksulluk kadınları orantısız biçimde etkiler.
ruleText: disproportionately = orantısız şekilde.

target: The scandal brought down the government.
options: The government caused the scandal to fall.
The government fell because of the scandal.
The government survived despite the scandal.
The scandal strengthened the government.
answer: The government fell because of the scandal.
why: 'brought down' = 'caused to fall'.
tr: Skandal hükümeti düşürdü.
ruleText: bring down = düşürmek / devirmek.

target: The bill was passed by a narrow margin.
options: The proposal was passed with overwhelming support.
The proposal only just got enough votes to become law.
The proposal narrowly avoided being voted on.
The proposal failed by a narrow margin.
answer: The proposal only just got enough votes to become law.
why: 'by a narrow margin' = 'only just'.
tr: Yasa tasarısı dar bir farkla kabul edildi.
ruleText: by a narrow margin = az farkla.

target: The authorities acted swiftly lest the unrest should spread to neighbouring districts.
options: The officials waited in case the disturbances spread.
The officials moved quickly so that the disturbances would not reach nearby areas.
The disturbances spread because the officials acted swiftly.
The officials moved quickly so that the disturbances would reach nearby areas.
answer: The officials moved quickly so that the disturbances would not reach nearby areas.
why: 'lest ... should spread' = 'so that ... would not reach'.
tr: Yetkililer, huzursuzluğun komşu bölgelere yayılmaması için hızlı hareket etti.
ruleText: lest + should = ...mesin diye (olumsuz amaç).

target: To the extent that voters withdraw from politics, democratic legitimacy is eroded.
options: Voters withdraw from politics only if democracy loses legitimacy.
Democratic legitimacy erodes because voters take part in politics.
As people disengage from politics, the legitimacy of democracy weakens in proportion.
Democratic legitimacy is unaffected when voters disengage.
answer: As people disengage from politics, the legitimacy of democracy weakens in proportion.
why: 'To the extent that' = 'in proportion as'; 'withdraw' = 'disengage'.
tr: Seçmenler siyasetten çekildiği ölçüde demokratik meşruiyet aşınır.
ruleText: To the extent that = ... ölçüde / oranında.

target: It would be naive to suppose that legislation alone could eradicate deep-rooted prejudice.
options: Believing that laws alone could wipe out bias is unrealistic.
Laws alone can easily remove deep-seated prejudice.
Entrenched bias is naive, so laws are unnecessary.
Prejudice alone could eradicate legislation.
answer: Believing that laws alone could wipe out bias is unrealistic.
why: 'naive to suppose' = 'unrealistic to believe'; 'eradicate' = 'wipe out'.
tr: Yasaların tek başına köklü önyargıyı ortadan kaldırabileceğini sanmak saflık olur.
ruleText: It would be naive to suppose that ... = ...sanmak saflık olur.

target: He gave up smoking when his first grandchild was born.
options: He kept smoking even after his grandchild arrived.
He gave his grandchild up when smoking began.
He started smoking when his first grandchild arrived.
He quit smoking when his first grandchild arrived.
answer: He quit smoking when his first grandchild arrived.
why: 'gave up' = 'quit'; 'was born' = 'arrived'.
tr: İlk torunu doğunca sigarayı bıraktı.
ruleText: give up = quit (bırakmak).

target: My sister is very fond of classical music and old films.
options: My sister really enjoys classical music and old films.
My sister is able to produce classical music and old films.
My sister dislikes classical music and old films.
My sister enjoys classical music but avoids old films.
answer: My sister really enjoys classical music and old films.
why: 'is fond of' = 'enjoys'.
tr: Kız kardeşim klasik müziği ve eski filmleri çok sever.
ruleText: be fond of = sevmek, hoşlanmak.

target: The match was called off because of the heavy snow.
options: The snowfall started after the match was cancelled.
The match was cancelled owing to the thick snowfall.
The match was held despite the thick snowfall.
The match was called by the referee after the snowfall.
answer: The match was cancelled owing to the thick snowfall.
why: 'called off' = 'cancelled'; 'because of' = 'owing to'.
tr: Maç yoğun kar yüzünden iptal edildi.
ruleText: call off = cancel.

target: I would sooner walk to work than depend on the crowded bus.
options: I depend on walking since the bus arrives too soon.
I would rather take the crowded bus than walk to work.
I walked to work sooner than the crowded bus arrived.
I would prefer to walk to work instead of relying on the packed bus.
answer: I would prefer to walk to work instead of relying on the packed bus.
why: 'would sooner ... than' = 'would prefer ... instead of'.
tr: İşe kalabalık otobüse bağımlı olmaktansa yürümeyi tercih ederim.
ruleText: would sooner V1 than V1 = ...mektense ...meyi tercih ederim.

target: It is no wonder that she was upset after such unfair treatment.
options: She wondered whether the unjust treatment had really upset her.
It is hardly surprising that she felt hurt after being treated so unjustly.
She was upset because nobody wondered about her treatment.
It is surprising that she felt hurt after being treated so unjustly.
answer: It is hardly surprising that she felt hurt after being treated so unjustly.
why: 'no wonder' = 'hardly surprising'.
tr: Böylesine haksız muameleden sonra üzülmesine şaşmamak gerek.
ruleText: It is no wonder that = ...e şaşmamalı.

target: She insisted on paying for the dinner herself.
options: She would not allow anyone else to pay the bill for the meal.
She could not afford to pay the bill for the meal.
She insisted that someone else should pay the bill for the meal.
She was insisted to pay the bill by the others.
answer: She would not allow anyone else to pay the bill for the meal.
why: 'insisted on paying herself' = 'would not allow anyone else to pay'.
tr: Yemeğin hesabını kendisinin ödemesi konusunda ısrar etti.
ruleText: insist on V-ing = V etmekte ısrar etmek.

target: However much he earns, he never manages to save anything.
options: If he earned more, he would manage to save something.
Because he earns a lot, he always puts money aside.
He saves a great deal, but he earns very little.
No matter how large his income is, he is unable to put money aside.
answer: No matter how large his income is, he is unable to put money aside.
why: 'However much' = 'No matter how large'.
tr: Ne kadar kazanırsa kazansın, hiçbir şey biriktirmeyi başaramaz.
ruleText: However much + özne + fiil = ne kadar ... olursa olsun.

target: What he lacks in experience he makes up for in enthusiasm.
options: His inexperience is a result of his eagerness.
His eagerness compensates for the fact that he is inexperienced.
He has plenty of experience but little eagerness.
His eagerness fades because he lacks experience.
answer: His eagerness compensates for the fact that he is inexperienced.
why: 'makes up for' = 'compensates for'.
tr: Deneyim eksikliğini hevesle telafi ediyor.
ruleText: make up for = telafi etmek.

target: Not for a moment did he imagine that the plan would backfire so spectacularly.
options: He imagined for a moment that the scheme would go disastrously wrong.
He expected the scheme to go wrong, but only for a short time.
He never suspected that the scheme would go so disastrously wrong.
The scheme went wrong because he imagined it for a moment.
answer: He never suspected that the scheme would go so disastrously wrong.
why: 'Not for a moment did he imagine' = 'He never suspected'; 'backfire' = 'go wrong'.
tr: Planın bu kadar korkunç tersine döneceğini bir an bile düşünmedi.
ruleText: Not for a moment + yardımcı fiil + özne = bir an bile ... -medi (devrik).

target: Under no circumstances should the data be released before the review has concluded.
options: In some circumstances the data should not be published after the review.
The data must on no account be made public until the review is finished.
The data may be made public in any case before the review is finished.
The data should be released once the review has been cancelled.
answer: The data must on no account be made public until the review is finished.
why: 'Under no circumstances should' = 'must on no account'; 'released' = 'made public'.
tr: İnceleme tamamlanmadan veriler hiçbir koşulda yayımlanmamalıdır.
ruleText: Under no circumstances + should + özne = hiçbir koşulda ... -memeli.

target: Patients are required to rest after the operation.
options: Before the surgery, patients have to take it easy.
After the surgery, patients may rest if they wish.
After the surgery, patients are not allowed to rest.
After the surgery, patients have to take it easy.
answer: After the surgery, patients have to take it easy.
why: 'are required to' = 'have to'; 'operation' = 'surgery'.
tr: Hastaların ameliyattan sonra dinlenmesi gerekir.
ruleText: be required to = have to (zorunluluk).

target: The nurse took the child's temperature before giving him any medicine.
options: The nurse checked how hot the boy was before he got any medication.
The nurse took the boy's medicine because he was hot.
The nurse did not check the boy's heat before medication.
The nurse gave the boy medication before checking how hot he was.
answer: The nurse checked how hot the boy was before he got any medication.
why: 'took temperature' = 'checked how hot'.
tr: Hemşire ilaç vermeden önce çocuğun ateşini ölçtü.
ruleText: take someone's temperature = ateşini ölçmek.

target: My neighbour suffers from asthma and carries an inhaler everywhere.
options: My neighbour has an inhaler but never uses it for asthma.
My neighbour sells inhalers to people who have asthma.
My neighbour has asthma and always keeps an inhaler with him.
My neighbour cured his asthma and no longer needs an inhaler.
answer: My neighbour has asthma and always keeps an inhaler with him.
why: 'suffers from' = 'has'; 'carries everywhere' = 'always keeps with him'.
tr: Komşum astım hastası ve her yerde bir nefes spreyi taşıyor.
ruleText: suffer from = (hastalık) çekmek.

target: A balanced diet helps to prevent heart disease.
options: Eating a balanced diet guarantees that no heart problems occur.
Eating a well-rounded diet lowers the chance of heart problems.
A balanced diet is the main cause of heart problems.
Heart disease prevents people from eating a balanced diet.
answer: Eating a well-rounded diet lowers the chance of heart problems.
why: 'helps to prevent' = 'lowers the chance of'.
tr: Dengeli beslenme kalp hastalığını önlemeye yardımcı olur.
ruleText: help (to) prevent = önlemeye yardımcı olmak (kesinlik yok).

target: It took him almost a month to recover from the flu.
options: He caught influenza after nearly four weeks of being well.
He was unwell for four weeks because he never caught influenza.
He recovered from influenza within a few days.
He needed nearly four weeks to get well again after having influenza.
answer: He needed nearly four weeks to get well again after having influenza.
why: 'recover from' = 'get well again after'; 'almost a month' = 'nearly four weeks'.
tr: Gripten iyileşmesi neredeyse bir ay sürdü.
ruleText: recover from = ...den iyileşmek.

target: She was advised against taking the tablets on an empty stomach.
options: The pills were advised against by an empty stomach.
The doctor told her to swallow the pills without any food.
The doctor told her not to swallow the pills without any food.
The doctor advised her to take food instead of the pills.
answer: The doctor told her not to swallow the pills without any food.
why: 'advised against taking' = 'told her not to take'.
tr: Ona hapları aç karnına almaması tavsiye edildi.
ruleText: advise against V-ing = V etmemeyi tavsiye etmek.

target: As far as I know, the therapy has no harmful side effects.
options: I know that the therapy is harmful as far as it goes.
I am certain that the treatment causes damaging reactions.
The treatment has no effect as far as I know.
To the best of my knowledge, the treatment causes no damaging reactions.
answer: To the best of my knowledge, the treatment causes no damaging reactions.
why: 'As far as I know' = 'To the best of my knowledge'.
tr: Bildiğim kadarıyla bu tedavinin zararlı bir yan etkisi yok.
ruleText: As far as I know = bildiğim kadarıyla (kesin değil).

target: The study found no correlation between the two conditions.
options: The research showed that the two illnesses are not connected.
The research found only one of the two illnesses.
The research showed that the two illnesses are strongly connected.
The research did not study the two illnesses.
answer: The research showed that the two illnesses are not connected.
why: 'no correlation' = 'not connected'.
tr: Çalışma iki hastalık arasında bir ilişki bulamadı.
ruleText: no correlation between A and B = A ile B arasında ilişki yok.

target: Whereas early trials pointed to a clear benefit, later studies have called the drug's efficacy into question.
options: First tests suggested it worked well, but more recent research has cast doubt on that.
Later research has proved that the drug works better than early tests suggested.
Early trials doubted the drug, so later studies have praised its benefit.
First tests suggested it worked badly, but more recent research has confirmed that.
answer: First tests suggested it worked well, but more recent research has cast doubt on that.
why: 'Whereas ... pointed to a clear benefit' = 'First tests suggested it worked well, but'; 'called into question' = 'cast doubt on'.
tr: İlk denemeler açık bir yarara işaret ederken sonraki çalışmalar ilacın etkinliğini sorgulatmıştır.
ruleText: call into question = cast doubt on (şüphe uyandırmak).

target: The patient, who had been given only weeks to live, defied all expectations.
options: Doctors thought he would die within weeks, and he died in a few days.
Nobody expected him to survive, so doctors gave him only weeks.
Doctors thought he would survive for years, and he did exactly that.
Doctors thought he would die within weeks, yet he survived far longer than anyone predicted.
answer: Doctors thought he would die within weeks, yet he survived far longer than anyone predicted.
why: 'defied all expectations' = 'survived far longer than anyone predicted'.
tr: Yaşamak için yalnızca haftalar verilen hasta tüm beklentileri boşa çıkardı.
ruleText: defy expectations = beklentilerin tersine davranmak.

target: Pure water boils at one hundred degrees Celsius at sea level.
options: Pure water boils at sea level only after it has been heated to a hundred.
The boiling point of pure water at sea level is one hundred degrees Celsius.
The boiling point of water at sea level is lower than one hundred degrees.
Pure water freezes at one hundred degrees Celsius at sea level.
answer: The boiling point of pure water at sea level is one hundred degrees Celsius.
why: 'boils at' = 'boiling point is'.
tr: Saf su deniz seviyesinde yüz derecede kaynar.
ruleText: boil at X = X derecede kaynamak.

target: The experiment was repeated several times to make sure the result was reliable.
options: The test was cancelled because the outcome could not be trusted.
The test was done only once because the outcome could be trusted.
The outcome was repeated several times before the test was done.
The test was done more than once to check that the outcome could be trusted.
answer: The test was done more than once to check that the outcome could be trusted.
why: 'repeated several times' = 'done more than once'; 'reliable' = 'could be trusted'.
tr: Sonucun güvenilir olduğundan emin olmak için deney birkaç kez tekrarlandı.
ruleText: repeat several times = birkaç kez tekrarlamak.

target: Sound cannot travel through a vacuum because there are no particles to carry the vibrations.
options: Sound travels through empty space because particles carry the vibrations.
Sound produces a vacuum because it cannot carry any particles.
Sound needs matter to pass through, so it cannot cross completely empty space.
Sound travels fastest through empty space since nothing slows the vibrations.
answer: Sound needs matter to pass through, so it cannot cross completely empty space.
why: 'no particles to carry vibrations' = 'needs matter to pass through'.
tr: Titreşimleri taşıyacak parçacık olmadığı için ses boşlukta yayılamaz.
ruleText: cannot ... because there are no = ...ı olmadığı için ...amaz.

target: Evaporation is the process by which a liquid turns into a gas at its surface.
options: A liquid is evaporated by the gas that touches its surface.
A liquid changes into vapour at its surface through evaporation.
Evaporation happens inside the liquid rather than at its surface.
A gas changes into a liquid at its surface through evaporation.
answer: A liquid changes into vapour at its surface through evaporation.
why: 'turns into a gas' = 'changes into vapour'.
tr: Buharlaşma, bir sıvının yüzeyinde gaza dönüştüğü süreçtir.
ruleText: the process by which = ...nin gerçekleştiği süreç.

target: The chemist is credited with isolating the element in 1807.
options: People say it was the chemist who first separated the element in 1807.
People say the chemist was the one who destroyed the element in 1807.
The element is said to have isolated the chemist in 1807.
The chemist claims that others isolated the element in 1807.
answer: People say it was the chemist who first separated the element in 1807.
why: 'is credited with isolating' = 'is said to have first separated'.
tr: Kimyager, elementi 1807'de ayrıştırmakla anılır.
ruleText: be credited with V-ing = V etmesiyle anılmak/ona atfedilmek.

target: Species that fail to adapt to a changing climate are likely to die out.
options: Species that die out will adjust the climate to their needs.
Species able to adjust to a shifting climate will probably become extinct.
Species unable to adjust to a shifting climate will probably become extinct.
A shifting climate will probably adapt to species that die out.
answer: Species unable to adjust to a shifting climate will probably become extinct.
why: 'fail to adapt' = 'unable to adjust'; 'die out' = 'become extinct'.
tr: Değişen iklime uyum sağlayamayan türlerin soyunun tükenmesi muhtemeldir.
ruleText: fail to V = V edememek. die out = soyu tükenmek.

target: The results were consistent with the original hypothesis.
options: The first explanation was made consistent with the later findings.
The findings were consistently repeated before the first explanation.
The findings contradicted the first explanation.
The findings did not conflict with the first explanation.
answer: The findings did not conflict with the first explanation.
why: 'consistent with' = 'did not conflict with'.
tr: Sonuçlar ilk hipotezle uyumluydu.
ruleText: consistent with = ile uyumlu (çelişmeyen).

target: Such explanations as have been advanced so far amount to little more than speculation.
options: Speculation has advanced more than the explanations offered so far.
Whatever accounts have been offered up to now are at best guesswork.
The explanations offered up to now are fully proven facts.
No accounts have been offered up to now, so everything is guesswork.
answer: Whatever accounts have been offered up to now are at best guesswork.
why: 'Such explanations as have been advanced' = 'Whatever accounts have been offered'; 'little more than speculation' = 'at best guesswork'.
tr: Şimdiye kadar ileri sürülen açıklamalar spekülasyondan öteye geçmiyor.
ruleText: Such ... as = -ecek türden olan ... (ne varsa). little more than = ancak.

target: Be it a microbe or a blue whale, every living organism is built from cells.
options: Tiny bacteria are built from cells but giant mammals are not.
Only tiny bacteria and giant mammals are built from cells.
Whether tiny bacteria or giant mammals, all living things consist of cells.
Cells are built from living things such as bacteria or mammals.
answer: Whether tiny bacteria or giant mammals, all living things consist of cells.
why: 'Be it ... or ...' = 'Whether ... or ...'.
tr: İster mikrop ister mavi balina olsun, her canlı hücrelerden oluşur.
ruleText: Be it A or B = ister A ister B olsun.

target: What little evidence there is points to a single common origin.
options: The scant evidence available suggests one shared source.
The scant evidence available suggests several separate sources.
There is little evidence, so no origin can be pointed to.
The abundant evidence available suggests one shared source.
answer: The scant evidence available suggests one shared source.
why: 'What little evidence there is' = 'the scant evidence available'.
tr: Mevcut az sayıdaki kanıt tek bir ortak kökene işaret ediyor.
ruleText: What little + isim = sahip olunan az şey.

target: A large number of students took part in the protest last week.
options: Many students organised the demonstration against the school.
Many students missed the demonstration last week.
Many students joined the demonstration last week.
Few students watched the demonstration last week.
answer: Many students joined the demonstration last week.
why: 'took part in' = 'joined'; 'protest' = 'demonstration'.
tr: Geçen hafta çok sayıda öğrenci protestoya katıldı.
ruleText: take part in = katılmak.

target: The government has promised to cut unemployment over the next five years.
options: The authorities have pledged to increase joblessness in the coming five years.
The authorities have pledged to reduce joblessness in the coming five years.
The authorities have cut jobs during the past five years.
The authorities have ignored joblessness for the past five years.
answer: The authorities have pledged to reduce joblessness in the coming five years.
why: 'cut' = 'reduce'; 'unemployment' = 'joblessness'.
tr: Hükümet önümüzdeki beş yıl içinde işsizliği azaltacağına söz verdi.
ruleText: cut = reduce (azaltmak).

target: She was elected chairwoman by a unanimous vote.
options: Most members voted for her as chair.
She elected every single member as chair.
She won the chair after a close vote.
Every single member voted for her as chair.
answer: Every single member voted for her as chair.
why: 'unanimous vote' = 'every single member voted'.
tr: Oybirliğiyle başkan seçildi.
ruleText: unanimous = oybirliğiyle (hepsi).

target: The rise in prices is attributed to a shortage of supplies.
options: A lack of goods is believed to explain why prices went up.
A lack of goods is the result of lower prices.
Prices went up although goods were plentiful.
Higher prices are believed to explain why goods are lacking.
answer: A lack of goods is believed to explain why prices went up.
why: 'is attributed to' = 'is believed to explain'.
tr: Fiyat artışı, malzeme kıtlığına bağlanıyor.
ruleText: be attributed to = ...e bağlanmak/atfedilmek.

target: He was sentenced to five years in prison for fraud.
options: He ordered a court to spend five years in jail for cheating.
He spent five years in jail and then a court ordered him to cheat.
A court ordered him to spend five years in jail for cheating.
A court cleared him of cheating after five years in jail.
answer: A court ordered him to spend five years in jail for cheating.
why: 'was sentenced to' = 'a court ordered him to spend'.
tr: Dolandırıcılıktan beş yıl hapis cezasına çarptırıldı.
ruleText: be sentenced to = ...a mahkûm edilmek.

target: As the population ages, the pension system comes under growing pressure.
options: The retirement scheme is making the population older.
Since there are fewer elderly people, the retirement scheme is increasingly strained.
Since there are more elderly people, the retirement scheme is increasingly strained.
The elderly are under pressure because the scheme has improved.
answer: Since there are more elderly people, the retirement scheme is increasingly strained.
why: 'population ages' = 'more elderly people'; 'growing pressure' = 'increasingly strained'.
tr: Nüfus yaşlandıkça emeklilik sistemi artan bir baskı altına giriyor.
ruleText: as + yavaş yavaş artan olgu = ...dikçe.

target: In the long run, investing in education pays off for the whole society.
options: Over time, spending on schooling brings benefits to everybody.
Schooling lasts a long time so society must pay for it.
Over time, spending on schooling brings losses to everybody.
Spending on schooling pays off only for a small group.
answer: Over time, spending on schooling brings benefits to everybody.
why: 'pays off' = 'brings benefits'; 'in the long run' = 'over time'.
tr: Uzun vadede eğitime yatırım yapmak tüm toplum için karşılığını verir.
ruleText: pay off = karşılığını vermek.

target: Not least among the causes of the unrest was the widening gap between rich and poor.
options: The disorder had many causes, none related to the divide between the wealthy and the needy.
The growing divide between the wealthy and the needy was one of the chief reasons for the disorder.
The disorder was widening the divide between the wealthy and the needy.
The growing divide between the wealthy and the needy was the least important reason for the disorder.
answer: The growing divide between the wealthy and the needy was one of the chief reasons for the disorder.
why: 'Not least among the causes' = 'one of the chief reasons'.
tr: Huzursuzluğun nedenleri arasında zengin ile yoksul arasındaki açılan makas da hiç az değildi.
ruleText: Not least = özellikle, en az değil.

target: Scarcely a day passes without fresh allegations of corruption in public office coming to light.
options: Almost every day brings new accusations of wrongdoing by officials.
Officials make fresh allegations about corruption every day.
New accusations are made once a week against officials.
Not a single day brings new accusations of wrongdoing by officials.
answer: Almost every day brings new accusations of wrongdoing by officials.
why: 'Scarcely a day passes without' = 'Almost every day brings'.
tr: Kamu görevinde yolsuzluk iddialarının yeniden gün yüzüne çıkmadığı neredeyse hiçbir gün yok.
ruleText: Scarcely a day passes without = neredeyse her gün.

target: Whichever party takes power, the next government will face the same budget constraints.
options: Only one party can win, and the following administration will face different spending restrictions.
The following administration will win the election because of the spending restrictions.
No matter who wins the election, the following administration will be limited by the same spending restrictions.
The winning party will remove all spending restrictions for the following administration.
answer: No matter who wins the election, the following administration will be limited by the same spending restrictions.
why: 'Whichever party takes power' = 'No matter who wins'.
tr: Hangi parti iktidara gelirse gelsin, sonraki hükümet aynı bütçe kısıtlarıyla karşılaşacak.
ruleText: Whichever + isim = hangisi ... olursa olsun.
